# Lawh-i-Sarraj (Tablet to Sarraj) {#.unnumbered}

## BH00006

*Translated by GPT 6.1 Sol on 15 Qudrat 183*

**1** He is the Answerer.

**2** Your letter was presented before the Throne and reached the seat of “He is not known through anything other than Himself,” and its contents came under the gaze of God. You had asked how a letter of the highest heaven can be changed into one of the lowest abyss, or affirmation revert to negation, or a ripe fruit be deprived of its sweetness, or a mirror remain deprived of the radiance of the lights of the Sun of inner meanings. Excellent indeed is what you have asked, and you are among those who inquire.

**3** Your question was most welcome, for today every soul who is unable to comprehend the difficulties of divine questions must seek and hope to receive from the river of divine knowledge and the Euphrates of eternal wisdom, that perhaps they may drink a sprinkling of it and find repose upon the carpet of tranquillity and certitude. We ask God to raise you to a station where you behold the Ancient Beauty with your own eyes and detach yourself from the sight of the peoples of the world, hear His melodies with your own ears and detach yourself from the hearing of all created beings, and recognize His Self with your own heart and detach yourself from the hearts of all who are in the heavens and on earth; and to purify you from the defilement of the world and all that is in it, so that you will pass by nothing without hearing it declare, “There is no God but Him, and the countenance of the Most Exalted is indeed His glory in the Concourse on high, His radiance between earth and heaven, and His majesty to those in the kingdom of command and creation.” Thus does everything speak, if you are among those who listen.

**4** For today God has enjoined upon every soul to examine and reflect upon His Cause with their own eyes, ears, and heart, so that, through the wondrous mercy of the All-Merciful and the outpourings of the All-Glorious, they may be illumined by the radiance of the Sun of inner meanings and attain its grace. The reason all people have been deprived of meeting God and occupied with anything other than Him is that they have contented themselves with mere fancy and been satisfied with what they have heard from others like themselves. They have walked the deadly paths of imitation and been deprived of the ways of detachment. The Cause of God has always been as manifest and radiant as the luminous dawn. That some have remained veiled from perceiving it is because they have defiled their ears and hearts with the pollution of people's words. Otherwise, if they looked to the fundamental standard of the knowledge of God, they would never be deprived of the path of guidance.

**5** Now consider for yourself: the matter admits of only two possibilities. Either the people of the Bayān acknowledge divine power, or they do not. If they do not acknowledge it, We have nothing to say to such souls, for they are reckoned among the religious communities of the past who considered God's hand to be fettered, as the Lord of Glory has related in His exalted words: “God's hand is fettered.” But if they acknowledge the wonders of divine power, then dwelling on questions of this kind is futile and will be of no avail. For powerlessness is a condition of creation, while that Eternal Essence has always been established upon the throne of power and might. If He so wills, with a word He can raise all who are on earth to the heavens of His Cause, and with another word return them to the lowest rank of creation. No one has the right to say “Why?” or “Whereby?” Whoever says this has disbelieved in God, turned away from His power, made war upon His Self, and contested His sovereignty, and is numbered among those who associate partners with God in the tablets of inviolable glory.

**6** Likewise, He has the power to raise up the Manifestation of His own Self among creation whenever He wills. At the time of His appearance, proof and evidence must be sought from His exalted Manifestation Himself. If He produces that proof which has always existed among people, further hesitation is unwarranted. Indeed, if all who are in the heavens and on earth hesitate for less than an instant, they are reckoned among the people of the fire, even if they all claim sainthood. He exalts whomever He wills and abases whomever He wishes. He is not questioned about what He does.

**7** Now consider fairly: if a person appears invested with all the expressions of divine power and, moreover, produces that proof by which people's religion has always been substantiated and the Cause of God established among His creatures, and yet someone turns away from such a manifestation, which is the very Manifestation of God, and, not content with turning away, rises up to kill Him, what judgment applies to such a person? Say: His judgment rests with God. He decrees whatever He wills, just as He has decreed in truth, but the people do not perceive. Has such a deed ever been permissible in any age or religious community? No, by His own Self, the All-Merciful, the Compassionate!

**8** If they say that this Manifestation must not appear, as those who associate partners with God have said, then God's power and will become dependent upon and subject to the will of His creatures. Exalted, immeasurably exalted, is He above that! Thus, at the Revelation of the year sixty, all people, learned and ignorant alike, were deprived of God through such meaningless, spurious words, and returned from the highest heaven of eternity to the lowest abyss of extinction, while imagining themselves established upon the loftiest seat of faith. How evil is what they have imagined concerning themselves! In the Mother of Tablets they are recorded among those who are deluded.

**9** In short, turn your gaze away from everything but God and look to Him and to whatever appears from Him, for all besides Him has been and will remain sheer nothingness. If today all who are in the heavens and on earth were to become letters of the Bayān, who are a hundred thousand degrees greater and mightier than the letters of the Qurʾān, and were to hesitate in this Cause for less than an instant, they would be reckoned before God among those who turn away and numbered among the letters of negation.

**10** God, glorified and exalted is He, bears no relation, connection, resemblance, or likeness to anyone, and all have been and will be honored and exalted according to their relation to the recognition of Him. The All-Glorious Beauty is established upon the throne of the All-Merciful, and the rays of the light of the sun of His grace have shone and appeared equally upon all things. All who dwell in the realm of existence stand on a single plane before His grace, and no atom has any distinction or superiority over another except through its precedence in recognizing God and meeting Him. Blessed, then, is the one who has recognized Him through Himself and detached himself from everything but Him.

**11** O ʿAlī, hear the call of God and enter a realm that has always been and will forever remain sanctified above names, so that no name may deprive you of the beauty of the One named, the Sovereign through the will of whose Pen the kingdom of names was created. By God, besides whom there is no other god, the purpose of these words is that perhaps you and a few others may rend the veil and enter the tabernacle of the Beloved's holiness, which is sanctified above the suppositions and imaginings of His servants. Otherwise, He is indeed exalted above the turning of His creatures toward Him or away from Him, and sanctified above all the worlds.

**12** When the sun shines, is it fitting for anyone to ask how the light of the stars can be taken away, while observing that the sunlight has effaced their brightness? Indeed, in this condition the stars seek the darkness of night and turn away from the light of day, for the worth and radiance of the stars are seen at night, and through the shining of the orb of day they vanish and disappear. Glorified is He above comparison and likenesses! For the orb of His beauty has always been radiant, and no one has been with Him. All besides Him have been created in earthly abodes through the will pertaining to contingent existence, and to Him they will return. He, glorified and exalted is He, in His inaccessible seat and His lofty abode, has ever been and will forever remain sanctified above all. It is most strange that people are astonished and bewildered by the change and alteration of names, although at every moment they all observe with their outward eyes the change and alteration of the manifestations of names and their dawning-places. Yet they have remained so veiled by imaginary veils and words that associate partners with God that they have become heedless of what they see with their own eyes.

**13** O questioner, do not regard the divine names and attributes as imaginary. Know that all things created between earth and heaven have been and will remain manifestations of the names and dawning-places of the attributes of God, exalted is His station. It is only that the human being has been created greater in rank and loftier in station than all else. If you ascend into the heaven of “You see no disparity in the creation of the All-Merciful,” you will see neither disparity nor flaw in the creation of the All-Merciful and the dawning-places of His glorious handiwork. Blessed, then, is the one who has soared in this atmosphere, where the wings of the doubters have never flown.

**14** Now consider all these manifestations of the divine names—trees, boughs, branches, and fruits, as well as roses, blossoms, and everything that grows upon the face of the earth—with what freshness, delicacy, and verdure they first appear, and how, after a time, they are all stripped of their delicate robes and return to the earth. How many ripe fruits undergo such a change that people recoil from their smell! In short, all undergo ascent and decline, change and transformation, except the universal Manifestations of God, who subsist and endure through themselves and for themselves.

**15** I swear by the Sun of the morning of inner meanings that the divine Tongue speaks in keeping with the condition and capacity of the people, for most people have not reached maturity. Otherwise, He would open a door of knowledge before His servants such that all who are in the heavens and on earth, through the outpouring of His Pen, would find themselves independent of the knowledge of all besides Him and would be established upon thrones of tranquility. In view of the people's lack of readiness, the gems of divine knowledge and the mysteries of eternal wisdom have remained guarded and concealed in the heaven of God's will, and until now not a word of them has been revealed. Hereafter, the matter rests in His hand: He does whatever He wills and is not questioned about what He has willed. He is the All-Knowing, the All-Aware.

**16** If you will listen to this servant, cast away the wings of limitation and imitation, and soar on the wings of detachment in this holy atmosphere of divine unity, so that you may find yourself sanctified from fanciful doubts and dubious allusions, and see yourself illumined by the lights of certitude. Listen with the ear of your soul to the words of the All-Merciful, that perhaps the heart may be cleansed of the obscuring dust of imaginings that has enveloped all who dwell in the world in these days, and may turn toward the Most Great Vision.

**17** When you attain this most holy, most inaccessible, most pure station, you will perceive that the purpose of all that was revealed in the Bayān from the heaven of the will of My previous Manifestation has been and will remain this Revelation. By Him in the grasp of whose power is the soul of Ḥusayn, nothing greater than this Cause has been revealed in the Bayān.

**18** Examine it with clear and penetrating vision, so that you may understand the intent of the holy words of the Lord. In all His pages, tablets, missives, scriptures, writings, and books, He has counseled all people and taken a covenant from them all, lest at the time of the Revelation they cling to anything that has been created and remain veiled from the Manifestation Himself. For on that Day nothing is of any avail except by His permission.

**19** He says to Vaḥīd-i Akbar: “Await Him whose countenance God will call to your remembrance, for you were created only to meet Him. He is the One who has made all things dependent upon His command. Beware, beware lest in the days of His appearance you allow the Vāḥid of the Bayān to veil you, for that Vāḥid is a creation in His sight. Beware, beware lest you be veiled by the words revealed in the Bayān, for they are His own words in the temple of His previous Manifestation.”

**20** Now reflect on these words of the Sovereign of names and attributes. With these firm verses and conclusive words, does any room remain for anyone to turn away? No, by Him who has caused the Spirit to speak within My breast—unless one should turn away from God altogether. The Vāḥid of the Bayān are the first creation, and all besides them were created beneath their shadow.

**21** He likewise says to Vaḥīd-i Akbar: “Perhaps He will come to you about the loftiness of whose mention and the exaltation of whose Cause you have asked. Those who are in the Bayān read these words, yet they pay no heed to His appearance, nor do they believe in God, who created them through a Revelation before Him, and they lie asleep.”

**22** Thus it is now seen that all recite the Book of God and write by night and day, yet they have not understood a single word of the Book. Rather, their purpose in promoting it has been and will remain nothing but to secure and establish their own leadership. Thus testifies the Tongue of God, the King, the Almighty, the All-Knowing.

**23** He also says: “From the beginning of that Cause until before nine is completed, the realities of creation have not appeared. All that you have seen is from the stage of the drop of seed to that which We clothed with flesh. Then be patient until you witness the other creation. Say: ‘Blessed, then, is God, the best of creators!’”

**24** He likewise says to ʿAẓīm: “This is what We promised you before We answered you. Be patient until nine has elapsed from the Bayān. Then say: ‘Blessed, then, is God, the best of originators!’”

**25** He also says: “Be sure to observe the difference between the Qāʾim and the Qayyūm. Then, in the year nine, you will attain all good.”

**26** Now reflect a little on these words. Reflection on the difference between the Qāʾim and the Qayyūm is also necessary, for the sorrows that have befallen this servant leave Him unable to expound the words of God. By God, besides whom there is no other god, the proclamation of the Cause of God has compelled this servant to write this Tablet, that perhaps a few lamps may be kindled in the niche of contingent existence and may arise, through the power of God, to aid this wronged and solitary One.

**27** Now all things weep over My suffering and over what has befallen Me at the hands of those who were created by My word. Beyond all this, matters have reached such a pass that, although the holy verses of the Lord pour down like a torrent of rain from the heaven of His will without pause or cessation, and besides these there are signs of power and divine manifestations that have encompassed the world to such a degree that the peoples of earlier religions have acknowledged and confessed them, I must nevertheless argue by proofs and establish by evidence a Cause that has always been sanctified above proof, so that perhaps a few may ascend to the heaven of direct witness.

**28** In God's knowledge there is no injustice greater than this: that the Ancient Beauty should prove His own truth by something other than Himself, when He is manifest and radiant as the sun at the zenith of the everlasting heaven. Those who have wronged the very Self of God will soon know to what place they will return. Inescapable afflictions and decreed ordeals have descended in such measure that no one but God can number them. At every moment, the spears of hatred strike the Temple of eternity from the direction of His enemies. The Manifestations of the Self of God came to Me in the forenoon, weeping and lamenting. They said: “Alas for the Joseph of God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting! His servants have cast Him into the pit.” Then within themselves they cry out for help.

**29** Say: O people of the Bayān! Do you slay the Primal Point while reading His verses every evening and morning? By God, you have done what the peoples of former times did not do, and honored servants bear witness to this, if you deny it. Do you slay God with the swords of self and desire, then sit in your seats occupying yourselves with His remembrance and citing His verses as proof? Thus has every community treated God when He appeared in the Manifestation of Himself in every age. Thus they acted, and such was their practice. Say: Today the Pen of God, the All-Protecting, the Almighty, the Self-Subsisting, will not move to record the names of these people. The gaze of God will not turn toward them, nor will the holy breezes of the Beloved of this day reach them.

**30** If the servants turn away from these holy divine verses and these manifestations of eternal glory, by what testimony and proof will they establish their own religion? Say: O people of the Bayān! Look upon the Most Great Vision with God's own sight, for He cannot be seen through any sight other than His own. Thus My previous Manifestation says: “Beware! Look upon Him with His own eye, for whoever looks upon Him through the eye of anyone besides Him will never know Him.” After giving His servants countless counsels concerning this Cause, He says: “O My God, You know that I have not fallen short in counseling these creatures or in making provision for them to turn toward God, their Lord, and to believe in God, their Maker”—to the end of His words, may my soul be sacrificed for Him.

**31** I swear by the Ancient Beauty that this utterance, which has flowed from the Pen of the All-Merciful, has set the heart of all things ablaze. Everyone endowed with sight perceives in these words the lamentation and yearning of the Manifestation of the names and attributes. Yet it only increases the wrongdoers in delusion and loss. O ʿAlī, open the ear of your soul and listen to the words of the All-Merciful revealed in the Qayyūm-i Asmā, where He says: “O Qurrat al-ʿAyn! Do not stretch out Your hand over the Cause, for the people are intoxicated by the mystery. Yours will be the return after this cycle, through the Most Great Truth. Then disclose, upon the Most Great Mount, a mystery of the mystery to the measure of a needle's eye, so that the dwellers of the Mount in Sinai will surely die at the dawning of a sprinkling of that all-protecting, crimson Light, by the permission of God, the All-Wise. He is God, who has indeed been Your Guardian in truth and according to truth.”

**32** And now the return is manifest, while the dwellers of the Mount are nonexistent and lost, as can be seen. Although He says that the dwellers of the Mount become dead, nothing, and nonexistent, they nevertheless express surprise that the fruit of the Tree of Bliss should become colocynth—as indeed they have asked this very question—or that the forms of the highest heaven should be transformed into those of the nethermost prison. The Cause of God has never been, and will never be, confined by limits. If all the mirrors of existing things face the sun in the heaven of eternity for a moment, the sun’s lights appear, shine, are imprinted, and are reflected in them all; the instant they turn away, those lights are withdrawn from them all. Look, then, at the sun and then at the mirrors, so that you may find a way to what the Spirit imparts to you.

**33** The exalted Ibn-i Nabīl has written tablets in proof of the Cause of God through what God has inspired in his heart. At the outset he has adduced this verse, revealed from the heaven of the will of My previous Manifestation. His words—exalted be His remembrance—are: “Say: O God, You are indeed the God of gods. You will surely bestow divinity on whomever You will, and You will surely strip divinity from whomever You will”—and so forth. Likewise: “Say: O God, You are indeed the Lord of the heavens and the earth. You will surely bestow lordship on whomever You will, and You will surely strip lordship from whomever You will”—and so forth. Although the Sovereign of existence has stated so explicitly that He bestows divinity and lordship on any soul He wishes and takes them from whomever He wills, is the mighty God who takes away the station of divinity and lordship, the highest of stations, unable to strip the robe of His name from a person, or to turn something sweet into something bitter? Glory be to God, far above what His servants imagine concerning His power! Exalted is He above what they describe! Now observe in what atmosphere the bird of power and grandeur is soaring, and in what places the people have come to a halt. What meaning have they given to the verse, “He has power over all things”? And what have they understood from “He does whatever He wills” and “He is not questioned about what He has willed”?

**34** O servants! Turn from the frailest of houses and take hold of a strong support, and turn from the darkness of ignorance and unknowing toward the luminous dawn of divine knowledge. Would that the people of the Bayān would ponder the blessed verse cited by Ibn-i Nabīl, so that they might leave the paths of illusion and enter the path of certainty. O ʿAlī! Drink a cup of this sweet water of life concealed in the darkness of the words of the Sovereign of names and attributes, so that you may be purified and sanctified from the troubles of the days, the doubts of humanity, the allusions of the heedless, and the arguments of the malicious, and so that the gates of infinite divine knowledge may be opened before your heart. Then you may become certain that the Sovereign of eternity has the power, in one hour, to honor and exalt all things with the robes of the most beautiful names, and in another hour to take them from them all. I complain to God of these servants, for they look upon Me through what they possess, not through what I possess, and they measure God’s own Self against themselves and His words against their words. By Him whose Self is My own! If all who are in the heavens and on earth were today to detach themselves and turn toward God, He would assuredly teach them such wonders of His knowledge as would make them independent of all the worlds.

**35** In this year of hardships, some of the servants have asked questions of this kind, and the servant present before the Throne has written and sent firm, healing, and sufficient answers. It is strange that you have not seen them. In this land, too, some have cast doubts, hoping to veil holy souls behind the veils of earlier words. Yet they are unaware that a soul who has soared in the spacious atmosphere of divine holiness and gleaned from the harvests of infinite divine knowledge will neither be held back nor deprived by fanciful doubts. Say: Whoever has reached the Most Great Ocean will never turn toward a mirage on a plain, nor drink of scalding water. Although it is not fitting that the Most Exalted Pen should be sullied by mentioning the words of those possessed of hatred, or move to write them, there is nevertheless no escape from doing so, in order to convey the divine messages, so that perhaps an ignorant person may enter the ocean of knowledge, or one lost in the valley of heedlessness and forgetfulness may, through the grace of the All-Merciful, advance. He indeed guides whomever He wills to the path of Bahā, and He has power over all things.

**36** But this discourse and exposition are for souls who truly seek the way of guidance; otherwise, even Salsabīl will not purify one afflicted with malice and hatred. Thus today most of the people of the Bayān have seen with their own eyes and heard with their own ears all the manifestations of power, the divine signs, and the revealed verses, yet they have arisen in such hatred that it cannot be described—except those whose eyes God has opened, whom He has strengthened in His Cause, brought out of the darkness of illusion, and guided to His mighty and praiseworthy path. They have clung to things that have never had any standing before God, and they are so heedless that they have bowed down before a stone and turned away from the Most Great Vision and the most manifest, most luminous Beauty. How many an object of worship is worth less than a hair of its worshipers! O ʿAlī! Say: Today you and the one you worship are on an equal footing before God. Whoever among you believes is safe from the Most Great Terror, and whoever turns away has departed from the path of God. This is indeed the truth, and beyond truth there is nothing but error.

**37** Beware, beware, O people of the Bayān! Do not disbelieve in God, do not wage war against the Manifestation of His own Self, and do not dispute with Him who has come to you from the Dayspring of the Cause with manifest authority. Do you imagine that the Cause of God can be obstructed by those who turn away, or that the light of the sun of everlasting glory can remain concealed within the coverings of darkened souls? No, by Him who has spoken within My breast, raised Me up in truth, and sent Me to all the worlds!

**38** Among the doubts that some of those who associate partners with God have raised in this land is this: Can gold become copper? Say: Yes, by My Lord! But the knowledge of it is with Us. We teach whomever We will through knowledge from Our presence. Whoever is in doubt should ask God, his Lord, to enable him to witness it and become one of those who are certain. The very fact that copper attains the rank of gold is a clear proof that gold can return to its former state, if only they understood. All metals attain the weight, form, and substance of one another, but the knowledge of this is with Us in a hidden Book.

**39** We say: The knowledge of those who turn away has not risen to the point of understanding that gold can become copper; they have not even understood that it becomes dust. Yet this much has been evident to everyone endowed with understanding: all things emerge from dust and return to dust. Dust is lower in worth and price than copper, for it is reckoned among bodies, while copper is reckoned among metallic bodies. This is plain and evident. If people had been found worthy and mature, some of the hidden divine sciences would certainly have been mentioned here. But what has been decreed has been decreed. It is evident to everyone endowed with sight that God—exalted be His remembrance—has always had, and will always have, power over all things. Certainly, if He wishes, He transforms gold into copper by the mere act of willing. It is in created things that this powerlessness exists and is seen. He is indeed the All-Powerful, the Almighty, the Omnipotent, the Praised.

**40** Purify your sight and turn toward the Most Great Vision, and detach yourselves from trees that neither profit nor bear fruit. This is among the wonders of the Cause of God. Whoever wishes, let him turn toward it, and whoever wishes, let him turn away. Whoever turns toward it does so for his own sake, and whoever turns away does so to his own detriment. He indeed is sanctified above all created things.

**41** Reflect on Satan, who was the teacher of the Kingdom in the Concourse on high and was known by the most beautiful names in the cities of names. Yet through one act of turning away, he went from the loftiest heights of the supreme companionship to make his abode in the lowest depths of the earth below. Thus does your Lord do whatever He wills, if you are one of those who are certain. Beyond these examples, why was the Ancient House, which had been the Kaaba of all beings and the place around which the manifestations of the names and attributes circled, deprived of this supreme grace? Reflect, then, O people of understanding! All things are held captive in the grasp of divine power, and at every moment He is able and powerful to do whatever He wills. The sway of His all-encompassing power over the manifestations of contingent existence and created things has never been, and will never be, withdrawn.

**42** Not every ear is worthy to hear His hidden mysteries, nor is every eye capable of beholding the maidens of meaning secluded within the chambers of His knowledge. How many embodiments of oppression have become known among the servants in the robe of justice, and how many realities of justice have become renowned in the garments of oppression! Consider the idols: half of those on earth now devote themselves to them and have taken them as objects of worship instead of God. They have been afflicted with this disease only because they have contented themselves with illusion and imitation and turned away from the Sovereign of divine unity. In short, today the manifestations of all names and attributes are seen on one plane and in one station, except those who have ascended to God. Thus do We impart to you, so that you may purify your soul and your breast of the words of the peoples of the world and hear what the Spirit has sung upon the branches of this Lote Tree, which encompasses all who are in the heavens and the earths.

**43** Say: O people of the Bayān! By God, the Truth, this has not come from My own prompting, but through what God has spoken within My breast. Whatever has appeared through My sovereignty and flowed from My Pen is My proof, My testimony, and My evidence, if you are fair-minded. Say: By what testimony did you formerly believe in ʿAlī, when He appeared in truth and came to you with manifest authority? By what proof did you acknowledge His verses, assent to His demonstration, and bow before the revelations of His Cause, the All-Protecting, the Most Exalted, the Almighty, the Luminous?

**44** And if you say, “We believed in Him through His own Self and were content with the testimony of His Self, apart from all else,” say: By God, this is His very Self, who has arisen among His servants and appeared with the sovereignty of His name, the All-Powerful, the All-Protecting, the Most High, the Most Great. And if you say, “We believed through the verses of God, the Almighty, the All-Conquering, the All-Powerful, that were sent down to Him,” these are His verses, which have filled the east and the west of the earth. Listen, then, to what is revealed from the realm of holiness, upon whose breezes can be heard what the ear of the Beloved heard on His ascent to holiness, then the ear of the Spirit in the heavens of the Cause, then the ear of Moses upon the Mount of glory, from the Tree of God, the Speaker, the Almighty, the All-Wise. Apart from these two, this Youth has appeared with a sovereignty that transcends all contingent things. To this the tongues of all beings bear witness, if you are among those who listen.

**45** Then say to the leaders of the Bayān: Where were you when the souls of the servants were shaken, when feet slipped and terror overwhelmed the hearts of the steadfast, and all the servants, of diverse creeds, rose against Me? I sought help from no one but God, who raised Me up and sent Me to the peoples of the world. By God, they were concealed behind the veil of women! Then, when the Cause appeared in its sovereignty, they felt secure within themselves and emerged from behind the veil. The first thing they did was to turn away from Him through whom their faith had been established. Such was the matter, and you were among its witnesses. And if you will not acknowledge My truth after what you have witnessed with your own eyes, all things will acknowledge My truth, and beyond them, the tongue of God, the Truthful, the Trustworthy.

**46** O Beauty of majesty between earth and heaven! Change the melody for the people of creation, then sing upon the branches of eternity in an exalted Persian melody, so that the mysteries of the Cause may be disclosed in what is inscribed by this firm and steadfast Pen. For not everyone is acquainted with the Arabic tongue, and understanding Persian words is easier for those who speak that language. O questioner! Do not regard as imaginary the names you encounter in the Book of God, such as Ṭūbā, the Lote Tree of the Utmost Limit, the Farthest Tree, leaf, fruit, and the like. In the sight of God, what is meant by all these names has been and will be the believer in God. As long as a believer dwells beneath the shade of the divine Lote Tree, that believer is reckoned in God’s sight as belonging to the Lote Tree of Ṭūbā and to ʿIlliyyīn; after turning away, that believer is described as belonging to the Tree of Fire and to Sijjīn. While in a state of faith, that believer’s boughs, branches, leaves, and fruits are all seen as belonging to affirmation; after turning away, they are all reckoned as belonging to negation. How many a soul belongs in the evening to the most glorious Lote Tree of eternity, and in the morning to the lowliest Tree of extinction! And likewise the reverse, if you are among those who understand.

**47** When a believer turns toward God, behold that believer as a paradise adorned to perfection, and see within that soul everything you have heard of paradise: branches of knowledge, fruits of divine understanding, rivers of utterance, and flowers of wisdom. All these, and more beyond them, as God wills, are present within that soul. Yet this very same soul, after turning away, becomes hell itself, together with everything that belonged to it. Thus does God exchange light for darkness and darkness for light, if you understand. Have you not heard that My former Manifestation on earth pronounced this very judgment, saying: “Whatever land a believer settles in is accounted in God’s sight as the land of paradise; and if an idolater settles in that same land, it is reckoned as the land of hell”? Thus today the seat of the Throne has come to be in a land that was never renowned. Yet today those who hate the Beauty of the Lord of the worlds have deprived themselves of ʿIlliyyīn and made their abode in the depths of Sijjīn, while imagining that they dwell in the loftiest seat of paradise, just as the peoples of the past are occupied with these same delusions. The Pen of the Cause therefore gives them tidings of the punishment of a barren day.

**48** It befits these people to take a calf instead of God, bow before it, and devote themselves to it, as indeed they have done. How could they be worthy to soar in the atmosphere of divine holiness or ascend to the heaven of divine glory? As can be seen, one whose nature inclines toward clay pays no attention to the rose. Thus does God offer a parable, so that people may understand. Have you not heard that He says: “Many a Tree of Affirmation becomes a Tree of Negation in the next Manifestation”? In short, today any soul who does not become detached from everything seen and mentioned among the servants, and does not regard it all as a handful of clay, will never be able to soar in this atmosphere or enter the dwelling of the Sovereign of sanctified glory.

**49** A believer has always been, and will always be, rarer than red sulfur. Beyond these suns of meaning that have shone from the dawning-place of the finger of the All-Merciful, it is abundantly evident and clear that a fruit does not exist by itself and for itself. Rather, through divine assistance, it has risen from earthly places until it has appeared at this rank, the station of bearing fruit. The Mighty One who enabled it to attain this station is able, through that same power, to return it and a hundred thousand others like it, in less than an instant, from the loftiest abode of eternity to the lowliest seat of extinction—and likewise the reverse. This has been and will be among His ways, for the all-encompassing power and irrevocable decrees of that Sovereign of oneness have always held sway over all things, and never for less than an instant has He been prevented from manifesting His power. Exalted, then, is God above what the deluded imagine!

**50** Many pearls of mysteries have been and will remain concealed within the shells of the seas of the name of your Lord, the All-Concealing, whose disclosure would cause unsteady feet to stumble. In short, today a grace has appeared such that, should He wish to raise up all the first and last Letters from a handful of clay, He has the power to do so. Nevertheless, it is a great pity for anyone, in these days when the Beauty of the All-Merciful has appeared in the fullness of His grace, to be occupied with anything other than Him. Leave all who are in the heavens and the earth to their own people, then plunge into the depths of this Ocean, in which nothing will be found but the pearls of the remembrance of the name of your Lord, the Most High, the All-Powerful, the Most Great.

**51** These are the wondrous revelations of the Sun of the Cause of the All-Merciful, which has shone from the horizon of the finger of the Sovereign of contingent existence. Blessed are those who act; otherwise, your Lord is indeed independent of all the worlds. How many souls today are submerged in seas of fire and are unaware of it! Rather, they consider themselves among the people of paradise, just as the peoples of the past rejoice in these same suppositions. I swear by the Sun of the glory of holy detachment that this Revelation is too great to need evidence or depend upon proof. Say: Its evidence is its appearance, its testimony is its own Self, its existence is its confirmation, and its proof is its arising between the heavens and the earth in days when all who are in the kingdoms of revelation and creation were shaken. And if you cannot recognize Him through what We have explained to you, recognize Him through what has been sent down from Him. Thus has it been ordained for you as a grace from Him. He is indeed the Most Bountiful, the Ancient.

**52** The Most Exalted Pen says: O ʿAlī! For once, set foot upon the Mount of sanctity and, with an unburdened heart and a pure tongue, say, “My Lord, show me,” so that you may continually hear from the imperishable sanctuary of holiness, “Look, and you will see Me,” and attain the presence of the peerless Beauty of the Lord of majesty—that is, the presence of the Manifestation of His own Self. Through a single effulgence of the lights of His grace, the trees of existence, unseen and seen, sing what the Lote Tree of the Mount has spoken. Such is the all-encompassing grace of the Sovereign who does whatever He wills. Yet the people are in great delusion, behind a thick veil, and in manifest heedlessness. Such is the condition of these people: they continually take pride in the word of the True One, yet turn away from His own Self. For example, they circle around the stone, traverse difficult paths from distant places, and sacrifice their lives and possessions to attain the privilege of visiting it. Yet they are heedless of—indeed, turn away from—the mighty Sovereign through whose word a hundred thousand stones like this are created.

**53** As was observed in the year sixty, and likewise in these days, they veil their radiant vision with a hundred thousand veils of vain imagining and coverings of self, and then cry out that the world-illumining Sun of everlasting glory has not risen. Even if they perceive it, they ask how the light of a particular star could be effaced or disappear, heedless that the presence of the sun effaces its light, just as one observes that in the daytime the lights of the stars are effaced and do not appear. Soon, however, the hand of God's all-encompassing power will create souls who will rend every veil and enter, without covering or veil, the sanctuary of the Lord of lords. In the path of the Beloved, no water will quench them and no fire will cause them to fear. They will reckon all but the One they worship as absent, and regard all besides the Object of their desire as nonexistent. At all times they will draw the people of the world of existence, with the chains of utterance, into the paradise of the holiness of the All-Merciful. I swear by the Sun of inner meanings that the lights of these souls will illumine the dwellers of the heavenly assembly, just as the sun illumines the people of the earth.

**54** O ʿAlī! Leave what you possess and take what God commands you. This will indeed make you independent of all the worlds, while anything besides it has never nourished or satisfied, nor ever will. Hold fast to the surest handle and abandon what desire commands you. By God, the Truth! This is indeed the firm cord that has appeared between earth and heaven. Whoever holds fast to it has been saved, and whoever turns away has perished.

**55** In short, whoever today wishes to recognize or comprehend the exalted True One without Him—exalted is He—is like someone asking a person blind from birth to show the way. This has never been possible. His proof is His verses, and His sovereignty is His confirmation.

**56** O ʿAlī! Listen to the divine words in the wondrous Persian tongue. If you do not listen, God's all-encompassing power will assuredly create souls anew who will hear His call and arise to aid His Cause. This is not difficult for God.

**57** If you have turned from the left hand of vain imagining to the right hand of certitude, and have received your portion of the river of the recognition of the Beauty of the All-Merciful that flows in the paradise of inner meanings, say: O people of the Bayān! What religion do you profess, and on what path do you stand? If they say, “We believe in the Point of the Bayān—may the spirit of all besides Him be sacrificed for Him,” say: By what proof and evidence have you become certain of that Sovereign of the path and acknowledged Him? If they say, “We have recognized Him through His own Self,” say: This is a blatant lie, for you have not yet recognized your own selves, much less the Self of God who sustains all things. Moreover, if such a claim is heard from these souls, why have they not acknowledged the manifest Self of God, who shines like the sun? And if they say, “We have believed through the revealed verses,” why have they disbelieved in these verses, which descend at every moment from the heaven of the unseen like pouring rain? Say: Do you believe in part of the Book and disbelieve in part? Woe to you, O company of wrongdoers!

**58** Besides these two stations, there are manifestations of power and signs of divinity that have encompassed the world in such a way that no soul has any scope to turn away, unless it turns wholly away from God, His Prophets, His chosen ones, and His loved ones. For nearly twenty years this servant has not rested for a moment upon a bed of ease, and has at all times striven in person to exalt the Cause of God. I swear by the unknowable Sovereign that, from the beginning of creation until now, no such power has appeared: a single soul, alone, raising the banners of power upon the summits of grandeur. Yet these idolaters have inflicted upon the manifest Beauty of the Lord of the worlds what causes the Faithful Spirit and the embodiments of the highest heaven to lament and mourn even now.

**59** If they say that these wondrous verses have not descended from the divine nature, just as the idolaters of the past said when the Suns of Truth appeared, say: The revealed Tablets that descended from the cloud of the glory of the Lord of the worlds in the year sixty are available, and these wondrous verses that have descended from the heaven of the holiness of the Most Glorious are present and visible. We will recite both before a number of people with pure hearts, keen sight, stainless souls, and attentive ears, so that the melodies of God and His holy fragrances may be perceived from the garment of His wondrous words. By God, the Truth! With the fragrance of a single one of those words, the fragrance of God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting, will assuredly waft. Yet all the people have been afflicted with a cold, and they will never perceive it, except those whom your Lord, the Almighty, the Beloved, wills. Although the rejection of those who turn away and the slander of the slanderers have reached such a point that pen and utterance alike are unable to recount them, nevertheless We feed the servants, for the sake of God, from the fresh, eternal, ancient, divine table of knowledge, and We desire from them neither reward nor thanks.

**60** By Him who has spoken within My breast! None of the peoples of the past are seen to be veiled as the people of the Bayān are. For in all the former Books the manifestations of divine unity were mentioned by allusion. For example, in certain passages of the Torah it is stated that if anyone comes and claims prophethood, he is a liar, for there has been no God but the God of Moses, no messenger but Me will be raised up, and no divine ordinances will come other than what has been sent down in the Torah. In one passage, He alludes indirectly to the subsequent Revelation, but it is mentioned beneath such veils and coverings that most people are unable to recognize it. In these circumstances, if His people remain veiled from the Daysprings of divine unity and the Manifestations of God, they have some measure of excuse to offer: “We did not comprehend the difficulties in the divine words, and thus remained deprived of the source of the river of the recognition of the Beauty of the All-Merciful.”

**61** Likewise, in the Gospel the Holy Spirit has sung and spoken of the signs of the Revelation in melodies that no soul can comprehend except those who are detached, for they were expressed in hidden symbols and subtle allusions. Those very passages have been recorded by the Pen of everlasting glory in Persian treatises. Look at them, that perhaps you may discover. In these circumstances, if this community too were to offer the excuse, “Our minds and understanding were incapable of recognizing these difficult, cryptic words,” some people might accept it.

**62** Likewise, in the Qurʾān, all of you have seen in what manner and language the signs of the subsequent Revelation have been sent down from the heaven of the All-Glorious. Among them, for example, are: “Do they await anything but that God should come to them in canopies of cloud?” and likewise, “The day when heaven brings forth manifest smoke”; and likewise the rending of heaven, the splitting of the earth, the crushing of the mountains, the kindling of the seas, the raising of the dead from their graves, the blowing of the trumpet, the rising of the sun from the west, the sounding of a cry between the heavens and the earth, and similar expressions recorded in the Book of God.

**63** Likewise, there is the mention of the Seal of the Prophets \[God bless him\], which is among the most explicit expressions of the Qurʾān. With these exceedingly difficult passages and subtle, hidden allusions, if people remain deprived of the life-giving waters of the Lord of creation and of recognizing His own Self at the Return, it can be said that they have not comprehended the divine utterances and have remained unaware of the meanings of the words of the Lord, for these were not readily accessible to human understanding. Nevertheless, all such excuses have always been, and will always be, unacceptable at the time of Revelation, for in every Revelation the proof is made conclusive for all who are in the heavens and on earth through the Revelation itself and through what appears from Him.

**64** Every soul must purify the mirror of the heart of all that people possess. After this purification and turning toward Him, the rays of the effulgent Sun will assuredly shine upon that heart. If God's proof were not conclusive at the times of Revelation, all would be absolved of obligation. Consider, for example, the people of the Qurʾān: whoever did not purify the heart of verbal allusions failed to attain recognition of the Point of the Bayān. For the mention of finality recorded in the Book was among the unequivocal statements of the Qurʾān. With this statement affirmed and its outward meaning established in the heart, a person will never acknowledge that Prophets have existed from the beginning that has no beginning and will continue to come until the end that has no end. Thus it is stated in the Bayān: “Purify your hearts of all that you have witnessed, so that you may witness what no one in all the worlds has witnessed.”

**65** At the time of Revelation, one must turn one's eyes away from everything and look toward God, for otherwise no one will attain God, the Most High, the Most Great. O servants of desire! Hear the melodies of everlasting holiness, hasten to the abode of “Recognize God through God,” and detach yourselves from all besides Him. These utterances of the Prophets concerning the signs of the Revelation

**66** As for the Point of the Bayān—may the souls of all who dwell in the surging seas of names be sacrificed for Him—He has set aside all these statements, utterly torn through the veils, and brought all these difficult expressions to their fulfillment and explained their meaning through the Manifestation Himself and whatever proceeds from Him. He has spoken of this Revelation of the glory of divine unity in such a way that no one has any room to hesitate, much less to turn away. He has made the whole Bayān and all that was revealed in it dependent upon recognition of that Sun of everlasting glory. He says that, at the time of the Revelation, they must not let the Bayān veil them from its Revealer, and that you must not cling to its words and remain deprived of the Sovereign of oneness. He specifically says: “O Letters and Mirrors! You have become proofs through My word. Beware lest, at the time of the Revelation, you act arrogantly toward the sovereign Beauty.”

**67** Although He has promised that the Sun of Truth will shine forth in Mustaghāth under the name of Him Who Will Appear—exalted be His name—He nevertheless says that, should He appear in the next hour, no one has the right to ask “Why?” or “By what means?” For that Sovereign of existence has always been, and will always be, free to choose. Anyone who maintains anything other than what has been stated has not acknowledged the freedom of God—exalted be His mention—to choose. We seek refuge in God from such vain imaginings. He has removed all limitations, veils, and allusions from this station. That Ancient Beauty has, from eternity and forever, been sanctified above the limitations and allusions of anyone other than Himself. No one has ever known, or now knows, the manner of His manifestation. No one will encompass His knowledge, and He knows all things.

**68** He also says: “From the moment the Sun of Bahāʾ rises until it sets is better, in the Book of God, than all the night, if you understand. God has created nothing except for that Day, for all labor to attain the presence of God and then His good pleasure.” In this connection He says: “Noon has indeed drawn near, yet you do not recognize that Day. As for Him whose presence is My very presence, do not wish for Him what no soul wishes for itself”—to the end of His words, exalted and glorious is He. O ear of existence! No one possessed of hearing is to be seen; you, then, hear these conclusive divine words. In those days He explicitly announced, without recourse to interpretation, that the Sun had risen and was about to shine at the height of noon, yet that you, O people of the Bayān, would not recognize that all-glorious Beauty on that Day. He also explicitly stated this name in His words, exalted and glorious is He: “From the moment the Sun of Bahāʾ rises until it sets is better, in the Book of God”—to the end of His utterance, glorious and exalted is He—so that no one should entertain any doubt or interpret it otherwise than God has decreed. Nevertheless, all have remained veiled by self and desire from recognizing the Sun of Bahāʾ and have clung to what Satan has commanded them. If only they had been content to remain veiled! Rather, some have occupied themselves with distorting these words of the Manifestation of the names and attributes. This is an injustice greater than any that has appeared in creation. Woe, then, to the wrongdoers, because of the punishment of a tremendous Day!

**69** After the appearance of this Sun of eternal glory, some of the Mirrors have indulged in vain imaginings and claimed the rank of a sun. Yet they are heedless that He has explicitly stated in the Persian Bayān that, if a mirror claims to be a sun, it is clear to the sun that it is its own reflected image that is speaking. He likewise says that mirrors have no existence in themselves. Elsewhere He says: “Say: O suns of the mirrors! You look toward the Sun of Truth, and your existence depends upon it, if only you perceive. You are all like fish moving through the water in the sea, yet you are veiled from the water and ask about that through which you subsist.” Now consider how He tells the suns of the mirrors, who are the foremost Mirrors, to look toward the Sun of Truth, for their existence and manifestation have depended, and will depend, upon His favor. He says that the suns of the mirrors are like fish in the water that move through the sea but are veiled from the sea and its water. Today, likewise, it can be seen that the Mirror of the people moves in the ocean of verses, for he establishes his own claim through the verses of eternal glory revealed by My previous Manifestation. His movement and the display of his station have derived from the verses of God. Nevertheless, in these days he has remained utterly veiled from the Essence of the verses and their Revealer. He moves in the sea but is heedless of the Sovereign of the sea. This utterance concerning the rank of the suns of the mirrors has descended from the Kingdom of eternity; how much more does it apply to the mirrors that stand beneath these suns!

**70** He likewise says: “On the day of His appearance, the highest of creation is like the lowest, and the nearest among you is whoever believes in Him. There are no ties of kinship among you, nor any cause for pride except your faith in Him.” Thus today it is seen that the highest of creation is accounted among the lowest before God. How many manifestations of the highest heaven have returned to the lowest depths, and how many dawning-places of negation have entered the sanctified abode of affirmation! He likewise says to Āqā Siyyid Javād: “I will surely complain to you, O mirror of My bounty, of all the mirrors: they all look toward Me through their own colors.” Consider how He complains of all the mirrors. This Beauty, however, now complains of the one who has become known as the Mirror, for he looks toward Me through what he possesses, not through what I possess.

**71** In short, even if all the Mirrors are designated in the Bayān by the names of divinity and lordship, and beyond these as the Self of God, the Manifestation of God, or the Essence of God, this does not suffice today. Until they attain certainty in this Revelation of divine holiness and this inward concealment of the eternal Unseen, they are all accounted as sheer nothingness and utter nonexistence before God. Thus, at the beginning of these Tablets, it has been recorded from the Pen of God that He said: “Beware, beware lest, on the day of His appearance, you be veiled by the Vāḥid of the Bayān, for that Vāḥid is but a creature in His sight. Beware, beware lest you be veiled by the words revealed in the Bayān, for they are His own words in the temple of His previous Manifestation.” He warns you not to let the Vāḥid of the Bayān veil you from the Manifestation of the Cause at the time of His appearance. This Vāḥid consisted of souls whom no one preceded in rank after the Point of the Bayān. Nevertheless, He says that you must not let these souls veil you from God. From this utterance it is understood that some of these Letters must be present in the subsequent Revelation. He also says that you must not let what has been revealed in the Bayān veil you from God.

**72** Now judge fairly, O people of the Bayān: in the face of this most explicit and complete statement, can anyone today oppose the Manifestation Himself, saying, “So-and-so is mentioned in the Bayān by the name of God; how can he now be stripped of his station?” No, by Him who strengthened the Spirit through My Self! For these names, mentions, and descriptions, even if all are conceded, are words inscribed in the Bayān. Among the counsels of the everlasting Sovereign is this: do not let what has been revealed in the Bayān veil you from the Manifestation of God.

**73** Moreover, I swear by the Sun of eternal glory that has today shone from the horizon of divine holiness: whether that Ancient Sovereign refers to the creatures of the Bayān by the name of lordship or of servitude, both are alike in that court. In the stone, which is inanimate, and in the three letters of its name, He has mentioned three supreme divine names. He has instructed His servants to look to these names when contemplating it, so that the signs of the Maker may be seen in what is made. If the Almighty who has bestowed these ranks upon a stone should take them away, is it fitting for any soul to object? By God, none will object to the Cause of God except a sinful transgressor. Had people known of the raising up of names, they would never have objected in any matter to the Sovereign who does whatever He wills.

**74** Thus some people are raised up in name and are renowned in the kingdom of names, yet their being has never ascended from the prison of self and desire, for a wisdom known to God alone. Many a reputation has no foundation. Others are raised up in their being, without a name, as you have heard in the account of Khiḍr: no one at that time knew the loftiness of his station except God. His reality was hidden even from Moses, despite His lofty station and exalted rank; and after Moses entered his presence, He was addressed with the words, “You will not be able to bear patiently with me.” Although he is mentioned in the Book by the name of Khiḍr, no one has known him except God, and with Us is the knowledge of him in a clear Book. Others are raised up in being, essence, self, spirit, and name. Bear witness, then, and say: “Glory be to God, the best of originators!” Were the degrees of this raising up to be set forth in full, it would be seen what station and rank are assigned to those who pride themselves on names. But We have stayed the Pen until God wills, and He makes every matter clear in a lucid Book.

**75** Moreover, all things have been and remain the repositories of the divine names and the treasuries of the mysteries of creation. In every dispensation He manifests from each thing whatever He wills and takes away whatever He wishes. How utterly astonishing that today, when the Ancient Beauty and the Sun of the Most Great Name have risen and shine at the zenith, people have nevertheless, because of one of the names, deprived themselves of the light of His beauty and of recognizing the peerless Countenance of the Lord of Glory. Say: By God, the True One! Through an act of will from His Pen, the seas of names and their kingdom were created, if you are among those who recognize the truth. Were He today to take a handful of dust and raise from it the name of all that has been and all that will be, He would indeed have the power. He is indeed the Sovereign, the King, the All-Powerful, the Almighty, the Omnipotent.

**76** By God! The eyes of the Prophets and Messengers in the exalted company weep for Me and for what has befallen Me; they lament within themselves and cry out in their inmost beings. Yet the people are sunk in heedlessness and grievous delusion. The people of the Bayān have fallen so low that the Tongue of the All-Merciful has occupied itself with such words as these, and still they will not accept them from Him. Such is the state of this people. Today, whoever does not ascend beyond the kingdom of names will never attain this most great outpouring of grace. Thus the Point of the Bayān states that the embryo of the next Manifestation has been and will remain mightier than all the people of the Bayān. Reflect on this, then, you who possess understanding. By Him who stands through His own Self! If the servants were to ponder this one utterance, they would find themselves independent of all but God and would have no need of questions and answers to establish this wondrous Cause. God speaks the truth, but the people do not listen, and

**77** He also states—exalted be His mention: “His likeness—glorified be His mention—is that of the sun. Were mirrors without end to face it, they would all reflect the sun’s radiance according to their own limits. If none should face it, the sun would still rise and set, and it is the mirrors that would be veiled.” Now consider how this holy, divine utterance conveys that the sun may rise and set while the mirrors remain veiled. Nevertheless, one may ask: after the dawning of the Sun of suns, around which revolve suns whose number no one knows except God Himself, the Knowing, the All-Knowing, how can a mirror be kept from the sun’s light and deprived of its radiance? Yet it is certain that the mirrors do not exist of themselves and for themselves; rather, they subsist and shine through the existence of the sun. Thus today, if all the mirrors of contingent existence turn toward the Sun of eternal glory, the sun’s light will be manifest and visible in them all; and the moment they turn aside, all have been and will be nonexistent and lost. Look at an outward mirror: so long as it faces the sun, the traces of its radiance appear within it; after it turns aside, those traces have vanished and will vanish, as is plainly seen.

**78** He also states: “He is that mighty Sovereign whose holy tongue, if it moves, creates with a word whatever He wishes and wills, whether prophet, holy one, or righteous one.” Is it fitting, then, to turn away from the All-Powerful, by whose word prophets and holy ones are created, and cling to one of the names, or one of the designations, or one of the mirrors? This is indeed nothing but a grievous wrong. By God, the True One! They have committed what no one has ever committed, for after the sun has appeared at the zenith, no soul has any grounds for hesitation. Yes, if they do not recognize Him through His own Self and find themselves unable to recognize that Ancient Beauty by Himself and for Himself, let them ask for proof and evidence—the very proof and evidence through which the faith of all the servants has been established and confirmed. And if He brings it forth from the seas of His bounty and grace, who can then hesitate, unless he turns away entirely from the Truth and takes his abode in the dungeon of wrath, the abyss of negation, and the hell of rejection? Thus most of those who today consider themselves reclining upon the lofty seat of faith and established upon the throne of certitude have turned away entirely from the Truth, are submerged in the sea of unbelief, and at every moment suffer an unprecedented torment, yet remain unaware.

**79** Would that they had contented themselves with rejection and denial! No, by Him who has caused Me to speak in praise of His own Self, they will never be content with that. Thus the soul whom We nurtured over the days and taught at all times the words of the All-Merciful, as the people of India teach their birds, rose against Me, waged war upon My own Self, turned away from My beauty, and disputed the verses of God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting. Not content with this, he arose to cut down the Tree of Divinity. When God brought him to ruin and what was in his heart became manifest, he then resorted to such plotting as no one can reckon except God, the King, the Almighty, the Omnipotent. He has fabricated and circulated slanders that the pen is powerless to recount, and has ascribed every wickedness manifested from the beginning of the world until now to the Self of God, who sustains all who are in the heavens and on earth. Yet he remains settled and at ease in his own abode, for he is confident of the fools among the people, who all tread the path of delusion and swim in the sea of imitation. By Him in whose hand is My soul! Had he perceived discernment in even an uncountably small number of people, he would not have committed these absurdities. But he is heedless that before long, from behind the veils of divine protection, figures will appear who, with divine sight, will distinguish truth from falsehood and the sun from the shadow. No bond will keep them from the straight path, and no barrier will deprive them of the momentous news. Would that someone possessed sight, to examine their words, which disclose their own selves and essences, so that he might recognize them and be among those who understand. I swear by the Most Great Sovereign that if anyone examines the words of those who turn away with penetrating sight, he will perceive the condition, rank, and station of these deluded souls.

**80** Today the leaders of the Bayān have advanced and continue to advance, without realizing it, the very arguments by which the lowliest of the people of the Qurʾān argued for the truth of their own claims. One example is the ordinance of appointed succession, which My previous Manifestation entirely effaced from the Book. As everyone knows, nothing concerning this was sent down in the Bayān from the Pen of the All-Merciful apart from letters and mirrors, nor did He set any limit on the mirrors. Thus He says in His prayers: “My God, send forth at every moment inviolable mirrors and pure crystals, that they may reflect You and point to You.” These words have been sent down in all the Tablets from God. Whoever wishes, let him examine them and be among those who understand. Now, just as the community of the Qurʾān fashioned a “Seal of the Prophets” and remained veiled from Him who sent and raised him up, these companions too have sought to establish a “Seal of the Holy Ones” for themselves, as has been witnessed. They have cast into the well of hatred the One by whose word a hundred thousand holy ones have been and are created. At every moment they hurl the stones of their suspicions from every direction at His blessed Being, while they themselves cry out and claim to be wronged, hoping thereby to instill hatred of God in weak souls. Such is the condition of the mirrors that have appeared. Say: If today God should decree that the name most hateful to the people is your Lord, or the reverse, no one has the right to say “Why?” or “On what grounds?” For He, glorified and exalted, decrees whatever He wills and is not questioned about what He has willed. He is indeed the All-Powerful, the Omnipotent.

**81** In these days they have written and dispatched treatises refuting the Truth, penned by fingers of idolatry. I swear by the Sun of inner meanings that, like children, they have uttered meaningless absurdities—indeed, they are even more contemptible, if you only knew. Now weigh the books and treatises of this faction against what has come forth from the servants of this House, and judge fairly for yourselves, so that today you may not remain deprived of the outpouring of the ocean of meanings that has encompassed all contingent things.

**82** Now the Truth has so far condescended that questions concerning matters of the Qurʾān are continually asked from every quarter, and He must write replies. For example, someone has likened a mirror to a ruby and then asked: a ruby may change before attaining this rank, but how can it change after attaining it? That is, before a mirror reached this station of mirrorhood, it could have been transformed or changed; but after attaining this station, how can it decline?

**83** Thus many have today remained deprived of the Sovereign of Oneness because of these self-evident matters. First say: O questioner, we ask God to grant you success and strengthen you, so that you may recognize everything in its own station, detach yourself from all allusions, and behold in the realm of existence nothing but the radiance of the lights that have encompassed all worlds; that He may efface every mention from your heart, and that you may arise to praise your Lord, the Almighty, the Unconstrained.

**84** For on such a day no one should turn toward anything created between the heavens and the earths. After the sun has shone at its zenith, should anyone occupy himself with mentioning the stars or inquire about a lamp, even if it is a shining lamp? No, by My radiant, sanctified, mighty, luminous Beauty! Leave every remembrance behind you, then hold fast to this Remembrance, who has appeared in truth and proclaims within all things: “There is no God but Me, the Almighty, the All-Knowing.”

**85** And if you have not succeeded in attaining what has been sent down in these verses revealed from the heaven of oneness, and still seek an answer to your question, hear the call of the All-Glorious from the horizon of supreme glory. Know first that everything has been and is being transformed into everything else, and knowledge of this is in the Book of your Lord, who neither errs nor forgets.

**86** And second, if you are asked whether God has the power to transform a ruby or not, what answer will you give? Powerlessness has always been the condition of creation, while God, the Inaccessible, stands at the center of power. With a single word He can turn all who are on earth into a piece of moist crimson ruby, and with a single word return them all to stone. Exalted is He above what you have imagined and still imagine concerning His power.

**87** And beyond this, place a ruby in the fire and then observe what happens, so that you may become certain of the transformation of everything except God. Likewise, when the ruby of the heart is afflicted by the fire of self and desire, it is inevitably deprived of its delicacy, color, and purity. Today many pieces of ruby have reverted to stone and are themselves unaware of it; and the reverse is also true, if you are among those who understand.

**88** Rubies are found in numerous varieties and different colors, and all their colors change in fire except for two varieties known as saffron-colored and pomegranate-colored. Although these two also change under intense fire over many days, albeit from behind a veil, no damage is observed if they remain in a moderate fire. Some hold that fire deepens the color of these two varieties. But if the divine fire known in the hidden divine science as the crimson sulfur is applied to a ruby, it is immediately calcined like other bodies.

**89** Fire indeed sets right all that corrupts and corrupts all that sets right; it increases the sound in soundness and the corrupt in corruption. Whoever has become acquainted with divine knowledge understands what has been stated. Without it, no one has any share except through a command from One who is All-Powerful, Almighty.

**90** In short, O questioner, change and transformation are evident in all that is other than God and in the Manifestation Himself. We created all things from dust, and We will surely return them to it and raise them from it alive. This is a promise from Us, and We will fulfill what We have promised you. I am the best of those who fulfill their promises.

**91** O people, hear the call of the Bird of Eternity from the highest Paradise, drink the most exquisite, delicate, and pure wine from the holy fingers of Bahá, and become independent of all but God, needing nothing from them, so that oceans of divine knowledge and wisdom may flow from your hearts and tongues and you may be freed and sanctified from such questions. Take care not to defile the heart, which is entrusted to you by the sovereign Beauty, with the pollution of the words of the wicked and the doubts raised by evildoers. For today they have come forth with every trick and deception, instilling doubts in hearts by every possible means.

**92** And beyond all these explanations, if something were found in the world that did not undergo transformation or change, what bearing would this have on the argument of these people? For example, if, as these people suppose, a ruby does not change, what connection does this have with the claim that one who has turned toward God cannot turn away, or that a believer in His oneness cannot become an idolater, or a believer an unbeliever? The King of Names has placed the possibility of change in some things and not in others. For example, copper can become gold, but the possibility of becoming gold is not actually present in earth. Since people of learning have discussed this matter before, this Servant has not wished to discuss it in detail.

**93** In the human being, however, the possibilities of knowledge and ignorance, turning toward and turning away, faith and unbelief are present and evident. If the questioner, in mentioning gold and ruby, meant them at the mineral level, this is very far from establishing his point. For even supposing that gold does not become copper and ruby does not become ash, one cannot draw an analogy from this concerning the other handiworks of the Maker. This is clear and evident to those endowed with sight who look toward the Most Great Vision.

**94** And if what is intended concerns the human level, it is known that gold and ruby, at the level of the believer, have been and will remain his faith in God and his recognition of Him. It is abundantly clear that this can change, for many servants attained faith at the beginning of the revelation of the Beauty of the All-Merciful and afterward turned away. If you rise above the realm of illusion and sanctify your heart from verbal allusions, you will observe the transformation of everything into everything else at every moment. Whoever has this vision opened to him is indeed reckoned among those endowed with insight before God, the All-Powerful, the Unconstrained.

**95** The essence of the utterance of the Countenance of the All-Merciful is this: the Cause of God has always been and will always remain sanctified above mention, description, and limitation. Whoever seeks through these veils to comprehend the King of all who dwell in the billowing oceans of infinity will never attain certainty. Through the power of the Sovereign of Eternity, tear through the veils of names and all that is below and above them, and enter the most mighty, most exalted, most inaccessible, most holy, most glorious City. For today all but its shade is fire, and all but love of it has been and will remain rejected.

**96** Someone has also asked about the numerical value of the revealed verse, “The Hour has drawn near, and the moon has split.” Say: O you who look at the words, set aside the numerical value and consider the verse itself. If today all who are in the heavens and on earth were to turn to this blessed verse and reflect on its hidden meanings, it would suffice them all. For today the sun of its inner meaning has shone from the horizon of the verse’s outward form, and it is a sharp sword refuting those who have taken anyone other than God as their guardian. The meaning of this verse had not become manifest until this inaccessible Revelation, for at the time of the appearance of the Primal Point there was no guardian, as people conceive it, to be split apart. Rather, there were religious scholars: scholars have been referred to as stars, the guardian as the moon, and the prophet as the sun. Thus, in this Revelation the sun has risen from the horizon of God, and the moon of illusion has split apart. Then say: Blessed be God, the most powerful of all who wield power!

**97** Now reflect on this revealed verse and judge fairly, and do not be among those who recognize God’s favor and then deny it. If only these people knew about this guardian and mirror whom they have taken for themselves apart from God! I swear by the Sun of everlasting glory that the true circumstances concerning the mirror were not as they have heard. Whoever claims to know has lied, by the Lord of Eternity! What this Servant has stated in accordance with God’s wisdom has become widely known among the people, but no one has understood the intent of the words of the Primal Point—exalted be His glory. This Servant has kept the truth of the matter concealed from everyone, for a wisdom that none knows but My own Self, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise. By God, he has done to his Creator, who created him through a breath from Himself, what no one in all the worlds has done. If people were to look with the eye of God at a single one of the wondrous Tablets that have descended in these days from the heaven of the glory of oneness, they would not remain veiled from God. They would see all besides Him as nonexistent and become certain that whatever is other than Him has been and will remain unworthy of mention, much less those who turn away.

**98** Some today have attributed infallibility to certain people apart from God, just as the people of the Qur’an used to speak without understanding; they have never understood what is meant by infallibility. Today the criterion of infallibility is established: whoever, after hearing the Word of God and His call, has become assured of the word “Yes” belongs to the people of infallibility, and anyone else is outside it. Thus the Point of the Bayán—may the spirit of all besides Him be sacrificed for Him—says, addressing ʿAẓím: “The Cause has indeed risen beyond limitations. You are to select servants who, when God revealed Himself to them, recognized through them God, their Maker, and did not hesitate concerning Him or entertain doubt, that I may make them like those whom You previously made prophets, successors, martyrs, and those brought near. By My life, were you to bring forward as many as the number of all things, I would surely do so, and nothing whatsoever would diminish from God’s dominion or increase it. But you see that supreme infallibility befits that station. Infallibility is not what you see among people in their precautions concerning their religion, for when they heard the call ‘Am I not your Lord?’ and did not say ‘Yes,’ they departed from it. Infallibility belongs only to those who, when God said ‘Am I not your Lord?’ said ‘Yes.’ God has never spoken to anyone except through the Manifestation of His own Self in every Revelation.” End of quotation.

**99** After this statement, the most explicit of all utterances, has descended from the Pen of God, who can any longer claim infallibility for himself except after acknowledging this greatest, most exalted Cause? Today all people, whatever their rank, are outside infallibility except those souls who have become assured of this holy, eternal Revelation. O servants, hear the call of God and cleanse the ears of your innate nature from listening to the words of the people of the Qur’an, so that you may comprehend the wondrous utterance of the Tongue of the All-Merciful. Reflect, after all: in which of their statements have these people been truthful?
