For one thousand two hundred and sixty years they maintained that Revelations had ended, and likewise that the Qáʾim existed in a particular bodily form in a specified land. Likewise, concerning the signs of His appearance, they clung to a thousand traditions, to such an extent that they considered those who denied these assertions unbelievers. Then, in the Revelation of the Point of the Bayán—exalted be His mention—it became clear that all had been mistaken, and that the Manifestations of the glory of oneness have always risen and will forever continue to shine. Consider likewise the other statements of these embodiments of error: all have been and will remain mere illusion. Their god is their own desire, and the object of their worship their own imaginings, if you understand.

**100** Although all the people of the Bayán have seen that what these people possessed was untrue, they nevertheless continually base their arguments and their discourse on the words of the people of the Qur’an. Thus these people now seek, by invoking the earlier appointment of a successor, to bar people from the Euphrates of divine holiness and the waterway of eternal glory. I swear by the Beauty of God, the Most High, the All-Glorious, that if a thousand manifestations of revelation had existed in the Revelation of the Point of the Bayán, and one had delayed for less than an instant in acknowledging the Cause of the sovereign King who chooses freely, he would have been reckoned among the people of the fire in God’s sight.

**101** Tear through the veils of illusion and ascend to the heaven of all-glorious might. If you wish the Truth to become known to everyone, let a few fair-minded people come to this city and examine the writings of God and His words; the claimants are also present in this land. Let them inquire thoroughly, so that the writings of the True One may be clearly distinguished from those of others, and everyone may be certain that all besides Him are paupers at His gate, powerless in His presence, and destitute before the revelations of His light.

**102** In the Persian Bayán the Divine Tongue has spoken—exalted are His words: “Make your utmost effort and exertion so that, on the day of the Revelation of the True One, His words may not be used to argue against Him. For the whole Bayán is the utterance of His previous Revelation, and He knows what He has revealed better than all creation, for the spirit of all is in His grasp. All others possess only a semblance, if they remain steadfast in the Truth; otherwise, it is not worthy of mention.” End of quotation.

**103** Such is the utterance of the Beauty of the All-Merciful. Now consider: although He has forbidden everyone to argue with that Essence of being, that pure Being who is worshipped, and has explicitly said, “Do not use the words of the Bayán to argue with its Revealer in the next Revelation,” nevertheless today everyone can be seen rising to argue, saying, “Such a person has been designated in the Bayán by the most beautiful names; how, then, can he fall from this station?”

**104** He likewise says—exalted be His mention: “Recognize Him through His verses, and exercise no caution in recognizing Him, for to that same extent you will be in the fire.” End of quotation. In view of these decisive words, all who exercise caution today concerning this most unassailable, most holy Cause are in the fire. There is no doubt of this.

**105** And His words—exalted be His mention: “If, in private between yourselves and God, you turn toward Him, it is His image that is in your hearts. Do not let it veil you from Him, and recognize the One for whose recognition you have been created.” And His words—exalted is He: “At every appearance of the Tree of Truth, those who believed in Him and His Book before become veiled from His subsequent Revelation and His Book, to such an extent that none remains but the pure believer, who is rarer than red sulfur.” End of quotation.

**106** Thus today all have been tested, and most of humanity have turned away from the Sovereign of oneness, saying, “Such a person has been called by the name of God in the Bayán.” Through such words they have remained deprived of the Sovereign of everlasting glory, unaware of what they have done. Even granting their assertion, they are heedless that all names stand on a single plane in that most holy court. He bestows as He wills and takes away as He desires.

**107** His words—exalted is He: “For no one knows of the Revelation except God. Whenever it occurs, all must acknowledge the Point of Truth and offer thanks to God.” End of quotation. Nevertheless, some have objected to the nearness of the Revelation, just as the peoples of earlier religions are all occupied with such objections. Say: Woe to you! How quickly you have exchanged God’s blessing and taken the paths of illusion and error! Although scarcely any time has passed since the Revelation, all have returned to their starting point.

**108** In short, the True One has always been free to choose and will forever remain so. He appears in whatever manner He wishes. He is indeed the One who chooses freely, and all besides Him is held in the grasp of His power, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting. By Him in whose hand is My soul! No injustice today is greater than this: that He who proclaims in all things, “I am God; there is no god but Him,” should have to establish for His servants that He has the power to change one of His names, when the kingdom of names is subject to His sovereignty, the dominion of attributes trembles in awe of Him, and the divine realm of the cloud submits to His presence, is fashioned by His will, was brought into being by His command, and returns to Him.

**109** Such is the condition of these immature, unworthy people. The All-Powerful One, by whose will all names have been created, through whose sovereign purpose all attributes have appeared, and around whom the Concourse on high circles, must offer proof that He is able to strip a soul of the robe of one of the names—even though they have never had, and still have no, knowledge of that name. Those who doubt the power of the Sovereign who does whatever He wills and this most wondrous, most unassailable, most exalted Revelation have regarded the hand of God as shackled, even if they do not acknowledge it with their tongues. To this the Tongue of the One who chooses freely bears witness concerning them, though they deny it. His words—glorious be His praise:

**110** “For people possessed nothing but words whose intended meaning they did not understand, and therefore they became veiled on the day of Your Revelation.” End of quotation. Thus today all have remained veiled by the words of the Bayán from its Revealer, although they have not known, and will not know, what God intended.

**111** Thus that Ancient Beauty wrote to the leaders of the Bayán: “Ask the Letter of the Living who has been in My presence about God’s intention in His words, for you do not know what God intends.” The Letter of the Living mentioned was Áqá Siyyid Ḥusayn, who was martyred in the path of his Lord, and no one attained his presence to inquire into the meanings of the eternal words. The purpose of this statement spoken by the Tongue of the All-Merciful was that the leaders should know that they have never understood, and do not understand, the meaning of the divine words.

**112** And because the manifest Revelation was near, the aforementioned Siyyid ascended to the highest abode. Reflect on this, O people of understanding.

**113** And His words—exalted be His praise: “Everything I have mentioned to you by way of demonstration is a spray from the ocean of the Manifest. And if you seek the secret of the heart, by virtue of the countenance of the Hidden, no allusion can point to it, nor can endless veils conceal it, nor does anyone need to mention a proof of it, for it is manifestation itself and the fullness of concealment. Glorified be God above what they describe.” Thus ends the quotation. That Beauty of whom He says

**114** that no allusion has access to that court of the glory of oneness, in honor of His presence and to declare the purity of His being and the subtlety of His rank—nevertheless, after He revealed the Sun of His beauty from the horizon of decree with all divine manifestations and every expression of oneness, they shot the arrows of malice from every direction at the manifest Beauty of the Lord of the worlds. The first to shoot at Me was the one whom I sheltered beneath the wings of My grace, whom We nurtured in My embrace and taught in My days. He is the one who killed Me with the sword of rejection, shed My blood, violated the sanctity of God in My person, and denied My verses after having bowed before a single letter of them and been created by a breath from them. He repudiated God’s right in My right, waged war against God’s own Self in My person, and openly decreed My death. When God restrained him through His sovereignty and exposed the secrets of his heart to those who had emigrated in the path of God, he resorted to slander, and his deeds and oppression were attributed to My wronged Self, to reassure those who followed him.

**115** By God! The heavens of the Cause have been torn apart by his deeds, the lands of holiness split asunder by his oppression, the covering of the Kingdom’s veil rent by his words, and the inhabitants of the cities of eternity moved to tears by his sin, while he laughs to himself as though he had done nothing in this world. By God! Everything weeps, yet he is not among those who perceive. Soon he will know, when death comes to him and his eyes roll beneath the assault of overpowering wrath, and he says, “Is there any return for me, that I may ask forgiveness for what I have done?” Then the clay of the abyss will be struck against his mouth. Thus has it been ordained for those who arrogantly oppose God, the All-Protecting, the Almighty, the All-Powerful. His words—exalted be His praise: “Glory be to You, O God, my God! If You say, ‘I have pardoned the Bayán and those within it,’ then all are embraced by Your forgiveness and Your good pleasure. And if You say, ‘No,’ then I am the one who clings to the hem of Your generosity and seeks Your own Self as an intercessor with You.” Thus ends the quotation.

**116** There has never been any doubt that the Ancient Essence speaks only through the tongue of the Manifestation of His own Self. Observe how much humility the Beloved of all existence has shown in these utterances: He has made the entire Bayán and all it contains dependent on the “Yes” or “No” of the Sovereign of eternity in the next Revelation. Now the King of the unseen and the seen is manifest to all, yet such suffering has befallen His blessed person that, were all the seas of the unseen and the seen to become ink, everyone in the world pens, and all who are in the heavens and on earth scribes, they would assuredly be powerless to describe it. If only they had counted Him among His own believers! May God’s curse be upon the oppressors and those who associate partners with Him. Nevertheless, they read the Bayán and have copies made of it. How many a reader of the Bayán is cursed by the Bayán itself! How many a person acts according to it, yet the very deed disowns him! How many a person makes mention, yet the Remembrance flees from him! May God protect us and you, O company of those who affirm His oneness, from these people, their evil, their scheming, and their deceits.

**117** Likewise, in a prayer to the King of names and attributes, He says: “I ask You, O God, by Your independence of all things, to accept the Bayán and those within it, for I have called everything that has appeared from Me by that name and made all of it a book, a leaf among the leaves of the gardens offered to You. If You accept it, O my Beloved, that is a manifestation of Your grace and mercy; and if You reject it, O my Beloved, that is a manifestation of Your justice and the self-sufficiency of Your lordship.” Thus ends the quotation.

**118** Although the entire Bayán was made dependent on the word of that glorified Being and all-merciful Countenance, they are now occupied with the lowliest of His creatures and remain deprived of His beauty. Woe to these people, and again woe to them! By God! They pass by nothing that does not seek refuge in God from them and disown them, saying in its secret tongue, “O heedless one who associates partners with God! By what proof did you believe in the Revelation of ‘Alí before Nabíl, and by what demonstration did you disbelieve in Ḥusayn before ‘Alí? No, accursed one! By God! You never before believed in any of God’s Messengers. Even if you believed at some time, that faith was not true faith but a mere semblance. Had it been genuine, you would not have disbelieved in Him through whom the mission of every Messenger, the raising up of every Prophet, and the faith of all who are in the heavens and the earth have been established.”

**119** A translation of these supremely exalted, eternal words into the wondrous Persian tongue is set forth solely for the sake of God, so that perhaps some souls may be cleansed of the defilement of self and desire and ascend to the heaven of everlasting glory, the station of recognizing the Self of the All-Merciful. His is the command; He guides whom He wills to His holy, radiant Beauty.

**120** Today, any soul who turns away from the countenance of the true Object of worship passes by nothing that does not say in its secret tongue, “O you who associate partners with God! By what proof and demonstration did you believe in the Beauty of the All-Merciful in the previous Revelation, and on what grounds have you disbelieved in the King of the path in this Revelation? I swear by the Sun of the glory of holiness that you have always been an unbeliever and one who associates partners with God. If at any time you professed faith, it was not genuine; rather, it was a semblance within you, and in this Revelation it was taken away. Faith has remained in faith, and Satan has returned to his abode in the lowest depths of hell. Had your faith been genuine, you would not have disbelieved in the One through whom the mission of all Messengers, the raising up of all Prophets, and the faith of everything in the heavens and the earth have been established.”

**121** O servants! Consider the Cause of God for a while with a pure heart and an impartial eye, so that perhaps you may not be deprived of the divine sanctuary or barred from the Kaaba of eternal holiness.

**122** O ‘Alí! Although you are the questioner and the answer is written in your name, it seems most unlikely that today you will acknowledge the Truth and take heed of all that has been mentioned in the Tablet, for your heart is concealed by thick veils and your sight obscured by endless veils of glory. Yet in these words God’s gaze and glances are secretly directed toward other hearts. Before long they will arise with such power that they will behold everything other than God beneath their shadow. Nevertheless, because His all-merciful compassion precedes all things and His divine grace embraces all things, this has been revealed in your name, so that perhaps the breezes of the days of God may seize you and detach you from all the worlds.

**123** His utterance—exalted be His beneficence: “You will always draw the comparison with the sun, and with mirrors for all that is other than it. Each mirror, according to the measure in which the sun has shone upon it through it, from itself toward it, then serves as evidence of the sun: all subsist through it. Were the sign through which it has shone upon the mirror, through it and within it, to be removed from it, there would then be nothing in the mirror that points to God. Likewise, when God removes what He removes, no judgment thereafter shall be based on the signs in people’s hearts. Even if they all say, ‘We are certain of God and His signs,’ God has not borne witness to them concerning what they utter.”

**124** O you who are stupefied by the wine of delusions! Hear the call of the Lord, the Exalted, the Most High, raised in these compelling words and these firm, unassailable verses, so that perhaps you may have mercy on yourselves and on the souls of His servants and cease casting stones of conjecture and hatred at the divine Lote-Tree of the Cause. Even if you yourselves are not guided, do not deprive His servants of the water’s edge of the Lord of creation in these grievous days. He says that all are mirrors and reflect the sun according to their own measure and station. In proportion to the sun’s shining in that mirror, the mirror itself then serves as evidence that all subsist and exist through the sun. If the sign of the sun’s radiance, which has shone in the mirror through the mirror itself, is taken away, nothing remains in the mirror to point to the One who illumines and creates it.

**125** Despite these firm, unambiguous, compelling words, the people of the Bayán have raised the objection: how can a mirror be deprived of the radiance of the sun’s light? They have become so arrested at this point that it is impossible to describe. They object to the One through a single radiance of whose most luminous name a hundred thousand mirrors are illumined and made radiant, and through a single radiance of whose name, the Withholder, all are cast back within the limits of their own selves. They turn away from His beauty, and after the Sun of beauty has risen, they remain at the point of its setting and ask, “Where are its rays, and what is its proof?”

**126** O heedless ones! Raise your heads from the sleep of negligence and behold His lights, which have encompassed the world. Some say, “He has shone forth too soon.” O you who lack sight! Whether sooner or later, He has now shone forth. Consider whether this radiance is indeed real or not. Its being sooner or later has never been, and will never be, in your hands or those of this Youth. Divine wisdom, which is hidden from the \[corrupted original text\] of humankind, has required it. O people, be content with what God has willed for you and decreed for you.

**127** By God, had the matter been in My hands, I would never have revealed Myself.

**128** O bearers of hatred! I swear by the Sun of the heaven of eternity that, had the matter been in the hands of this servant, I would never have made Myself known, for My name is ashamed to be mentioned by these impure, lying tongues. Whenever I have remained still and chosen silence, the Holy Spirit has spoken at My right hand, the Most Great Spirit before My face, the Faithful Spirit above My head, and the Spirit of Glory within My breast. And now, if you listen with a discerning ear, you will hear the call of God from all My limbs, My inmost parts, My veins, and My nails. Even from My hairs you will hear that there is no God but Him, and that this Beauty is indeed His glory for all who are in the heavens and on the earth.

**129** And if this is My sin, by God, it is not of My own doing, but comes from the One who sent Me, raised Me up in truth, and made Me a lamp for the worlds. O people! By God, the fragrance of truthfulness is readily and clearly distinguished from falsehood. Do not wish for the True One Himself what you do not wish for yourselves. Reflect a little, after all: what has been, and what will be, the purpose of this Youth in these latter days in this Most Great Prison? Reflect, O assembly of the heedless!

**130** O people! Feel shame before God and do not doubt His Cause. Do not ask for proof of the sun and its shining, for its proof is its radiance and its light. Do not doubt its appearance, for it has risen and cannot be turned back. Rather, ask God to open your sight so that you may perceive its lights, which have encompassed both worlds. Say: By God, the Pen of Holiness has inscribed upon My radiant brow, with the pure essence of musk, in a most glorious script:

**131** “O assembly of earth and heaven! This is indeed the Beloved, whose like the eye of creation has never beheld, nor has the eye of origination seen His equal. He is indeed the One in whose beauty the eye of God, the King, the Almighty, the Beautiful, has found delight.” There is an earlier tradition that one of the companions of the Messenger of God held a page of the Torah in his hand. He asked, “What do you have in your hand?” The companion replied, “The Torah.” He said, “Put it down. If its author were here, he would obey Me.” Now consider: you deem it permissible to forbid taking up and reading the Book of God, through which the authority of all—Prophet, Letters, Mirrors, Gates, and Pillars—has been established and confirmed. Yet you deem it impermissible to change one of the Mirrors, whose standing, by your own account, was established through the existence of Letters whose own standing was confirmed and established through the Book. Woe to you! You say what you do not understand and suppose that you are rightly guided, just as the religious communities of the past suppose, and in this they rejoice. By God, no one has any protection from the command of God unless they detach themselves from everyone in the heavens and on earth and turn toward God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting. Purify your vision so that today you may behold all things on a single plane and, with both your outward and inward eyes and sight, behold the lights of the Sun of holiness shining from the horizon of the robe.

**132** Apart from all these proofs, consider Mírzá Asadu’lláh, whom the Primal Point—exalted be His mention—addressed as “O Manifestation of Oneness!” Now judge fairly: how can you call someone who, according to the word of God, is the place where the Sovereign of Oneness is manifested, “the Father of Evils”? If you say that the Mirror deprived him of this station, then, assuming that this is permissible, what objection can be raised against that Ancient Beauty if the Point Himself now strips one of the Mirrors of the robe of acceptance? And if you ask how it has been established that this visible Point and all-embracing Word is truthful in His claim, We say: through the very same proof and evidence by which you have accepted everything that appeared from Me and was sent down by Me in My previous revelation. Now look for and seek that same proof and evidence. If you see it, do not disbelieve in God, who created you by His command, if you are fair-minded. He likewise says to Asadu’lláh: “O Letter of the Third, who believes in Him whom God will make manifest—exalted be His majesty!”

**133** Likewise, in the Treatise of Jafr, which was sent down especially for him from the heaven of the divine Essence, the following is written at the beginning of the treatise: “What has been sent down for His Honor the Lion, the Single, the One, illumined by the everlasting Light, the Name of God, the Judge, for God, the One, the Relied-Upon.” He then says—exalted be His mention: “O Name of the Judge! This is a hidden, treasured knowledge that We have entrusted to you, and We have bestowed upon you an honor from God, for the eye of your heart is discerning: you know its worth and cherish its splendor.” He then says—exalted be His station: “O most exalted Name! Regard these people only as sheep that their shepherd drives wherever he wills.” Besides what has been mentioned, words of everlasting holiness revealed in his praise are found in the Book; consult it. This servant has not quoted them for the sake of brevity. O you who are blind from birth in the realm of existence, open your eyes!

**134** Consider your own delusion: you now stand astonished and bewildered at the very act that you yourself commit and practice. You call Dayyán “base” and have named the Single, the One—one of the greatest names of God—“the Father of Evils.” Yet you object to the Sovereign who does whatever He wills, asking how the sweet can become bitter or a mirror turn to stone. Asadu’lláh, however, did not deny the True One. On arriving in the City of God, he entered the presence of the Throne and acknowledged what the people of the Bayán acknowledged on that day. Nevertheless, there befell him what befell him. Nor did you content yourself with him alone: you pronounced a death sentence against a number of people. The book Mustayqiẓ is available; consult it.

**135** I swear by the Sun of inner meanings that in that book a sentence of death has been issued against all the manifestations of Oneness, even though the death penalty has been entirely removed from the Bayán and its people by the explicit text of the Revealer of the Bayán. They have leveled one or two false accusations against that hapless man and pronounced a death sentence without God’s permission. How many a slain person has a single hair worth more than a thousand of his killers! Thus, even now, they have inflicted such evident and manifest injustice upon the Beauty of Oneness and have risen to kill Him. Yet they have written far and wide, attributing so many injustices to the very Essence of justice, its Source and Wellspring, hoping perhaps to instill malice and hatred in the hearts of some who are prey to delusions. But they are unaware that God has servants beneath the shadow of His name, the All-Seeing, who split a hair with a hair, and whose sight the veils of all the worlds will never obstruct.

**136** Likewise, He says to Siyyid Ibráhím—exalted be His mention: “O My Friend in the Scriptures! O My Remembrance in the Books after the Scriptures! O My Name in the Bayán!”—and so on to the end of what was revealed. Such is the divine utterance that flowed from the Pen of everlasting holiness in his mention; yet he has now become known as “the Father of Calamities,” even though they themselves take pride in having been mentioned in the divine Books as “the Remembrance of God among the worlds.” They call someone designated as the Friend in the divine Scriptures, the Remembrance of God in the revealed Books, and the Name of God in the Bayán “the Father of Calamities.” Yet in the case of one beneath him, who has objected to the very Will of God and His greatness, they consider change impermissible. They have supposed divine power to be like their own power and have regarded the Most Exalted Pen as idle.

**137** I swear by the wrongs I have suffered that the Pen of power is at every moment engaged in effacing and confirming, and none understands this except those who are detached. Thus the All-Merciful effaces whatever He wills and confirms, and with Him is the Mother of the Bayán. How astonishing are these people who take pride in these names yet have turned away from the True One! Yes, these designations and attributes remain in each soul so long as they have not left the stronghold of the Cause of God. Otherwise, they have no worth before God, not even as much as the black of a dead ant’s eye. Beyond this, all things have been and will be the Remembrance of God among the worlds, for all things, by their very being, are the Name of God, and His name—exalted be His glory—is His remembrance among His servants. So it has ever been, and so it will ever remain.

**138** I swear by Him who is peerless in might and glory: were it not that the gaze of God has found humanity immature, I would open within every atom of existence doors to knowledge before which all people would find themselves powerless and incapable of comprehension. But since strangers are present, it is better that the mysteries remain concealed. Thus has it been decreed by One who is all-powerful and almighty. Say: “O people of the Bayán! You were created to meet Me, though I have no need of you; you were promised My own Self and its recognition, though I am sanctified above your recognition; and you were given the glad tidings of My beauty, though I am exalted above you and whatever has been created between the heavens and the earths.” Yet today you have clung to the feeblest of names and remained far from, and heedless of, the Sovereign of names. If you look to the words, the equivalent of the Bayán has descended from the heaven of the All-Merciful and has appeared in such a manner that no one has any grounds for turning away, except those who associate partners with God, whose sickness of heart has prevented them from recognition and understanding.

**139** Beyond this, weigh the words of those who today circle around the Cause of God against the words of the one whom you have taken as your guardian instead of God, so that you may become aware of the greatness of the Cause and perhaps refrain from harming the Ancient Beauty on the basis of mere conjecture. I swear by the True One: if the followers of any former religion should offer unworthy excuses for remaining veiled from the Manifestations of everlasting glory, that might be possible; but for the people of the Bayán no argument or excuse remains. For the Sovereign of oneness has spoken of the next Revelation in the most explicit language and the clearest exposition, making the entire Bayán and all that was revealed in it dependent on His word, as was previously written by the Pen of eternity. Blessed, then, are those who recognize.

**140** Among other things, in seeking to invalidate the truth and establish falsehood, the one who has turned away from God has resorted to these words. Since it was not fitting to quote his words exactly, the Pen of God was not moved to record them. Their substance, as it now issues from the Pen of glory, is this: “Did your Beloved possess sight or not? If sight is denied to the Most Great Countenance, this is an injustice against God. But if that Sovereign of eternity possessed sight and knowledge, how can someone whom He praises and mentions by the most beautiful names fall from his station and be counted among those who turn away?”

**141** First, the speaker of these words has failed to recognize that the True One—exalted be His mention—does whatever He wills, and has denied the all-encompassing power of God. Such a person has been and will remain the most remote of servants, according to the explicit text of the Point of the Bayán, as previously cited: “Say: O God, You are indeed the God of gods. You will surely bestow divinity on whomever You will, and You will surely strip divinity from whomever You will,” continuing to “You are powerful over all things.” “Say: O God, You are indeed the supreme Lord of the heavens and the earth. You will surely bestow lordship on whomever You will, and You will surely strip lordship from whomever You will,” and so on to the end of what was revealed.

**142** Now We ask: what do you say about this all-embracing utterance that has flowed from the pure, innate nature of the Sovereign of oneness? If you acknowledge the truthfulness of the True One—glorified and exalted be He—then an all-powerful Sovereign who can bestow divinity and lordship, the greatest of stations, on any soul He wills, and likewise take them from any soul He wishes, is certainly able to strip a soul of the robe of praise. This is a statement He has made in universal terms; it has never been restricted to any particular person.

**143** But if you focus on the specific bestowal of praise, regard the hand of God as fettered, and deny His all-encompassing power, what do you say about Mírzá Asadu’lláh, concerning whom He explicitly says: “O Letter of the Third, who believes in Him whom God will make manifest!” It is abundantly clear that the Third Letter of Him whom God will make manifest—exalted be His majesty—outranks the Letters of the Bayán and its Mirrors by a hundred thousand degrees in the sight of God. For the Point of the Bayán Himself—may the souls of all besides Him be sacrificed for Him—says: “A one-year-old embryo of the time of Him whom God will make manifest is mightier than all who are in the Bayán.”

**144** Now judge fairly: did the Point of the Bayán possess insight or not? If you consider Him truthful and possessed of sight, why did you call a person whom He mentioned in the very Book with such loftiness, inaccessibility, sublimity, and exaltation “the Father of Evils,” and order his killing? O you with but one eye! You have seen the faults of others and remained heedless of what is within yourself.

**145** If you say, “He turned away from the True One, and therefore this judgment was passed upon him,” We reply, granting this for the sake of argument: if the Third Letter of Him whom God will make manifest, who, according to the explicit text of the Pen of the Cause, was more glorious and exalted in the sight of God than the people of the Bayán, can become one who turns away, an unbeliever, and one who associates partners with God, why do you not admit that one Mirror among countless Mirrors can turn away from the True One? Thus was the one who disbelieved confounded.

**146** By God, no one is aware of the true nature of this Cause; if they became aware, they would surely recognize.

**147** In the Tablet to Vaḥíd-i Akbar, the Dove of eternity has sung in the most wondrous melodies. What joy for one who listens and is among those who ponder the verses of God! His words—exalted be His utterance—are: “I swear by Him who split the seed and created the soul: if I were certain that on the day of His appearance you would not believe in Him, I would remove from you the designation of faith in that Revelation, for you were created for Him alone. And if I knew that one of the Christians would believe in Him, I would make him the solace of My eyes and pronounce him a believer in that Revelation, without witnessing anything from him.” Here ends the quotation.

**148** He says: “I swear by the All-Powerful One who split the seed of hearts and created humanity: if I were certain that in the next Revelation you would not believe in that Dawning-Place of the Sun of Truth, I would remove from you the designation of faith in this Revelation, for you were created solely to recognize that Sun of the heaven of certitude. And if I should know that one of the Christians would attain recognition of that Beauty of the All-Merciful and faith in Him, I would assuredly make him the solace of My eyes and pronounce him a believer in this Revelation, without any deed of his being taken into account.”

**149** Now, O people of insight, consider how gracious and tender the Cause of God is, and how God’s all-embracing mercy encompasses the whole of existence: solely on account of faith in the next Revelation, that divine Lote-Tree has associated a Christian who today is an unbeliever and one who associates partners with God with the most delicate and tender of His blessed bodily members, and has linked him to them. Yet at what a level these rabble of the earth remain, and from what a standpoint they look! Away with you, O company of the heedless!

**150** I swear by Him who today has made His own Self His proof and what flows from His luminous Pen His authority: if all who are in the Bayán should turn away today and one Christian become a believer, the names of all would assuredly be effaced from the Preserved Tablet, and the name of the Christian confirmed. God effaces whatever He wills and confirms, and with Him is the Mother of the Book.

**151** Beyond all this, have they not heard the account of Balaam recorded in the divine Books? Although he was one of the appointed successors of the former Prophets, and all the peoples throughout the world considered service to him obligatory and obedience to him obedience to God, and the fame of his name had spread through every land, when the beauty of Moses appeared from the horizon of glorious submission, he arose to oppose that Beauty of oneness. Likewise, Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve Letters of the Gospel, delivered the Spirit into the hands of the Jews.

**152** Beware lest you feel secure from divine trials and tests. At every moment seek refuge in God, the Most Exalted, so that perhaps today you may neither stray from the clear path nor stumble. Blessed are the steadfast! For testing has been and will remain the lot of all, and no one is beyond its snare except those whom your Lord wills. Should the breeze of His justice pass by, you would see a hundred thousand essences of light in the darkness of self and desire; and should the breeze of His grace blow, you would behold a hundred thousand mortal forms at the seat of the everlasting throne.

**153** By God, O people, you are unaware and act on mere conjecture. Listen to the wondrous counsels of God, do not act presumptuously in the Cause of God, and do not subject yourselves to unending torment. Do not turn from the surging Most Great Ocean to occupy yourselves with a mirage on a barren plain, and do not forsake the Sun of everlasting glory to content yourselves with a fleeting shadow. Hear the utterance of the True One from the tongue of the All-Merciful.

**154** No one today is aware of the Bayán and what is treasured within it. Its knowledge is with Us, if you are among those who understand. Do not let the garment of a name veil you from the Sovereign who bears the names, through whose word the kingdom of names was created. For all names are like garments: He clothes whomever He wills in them as a grace from Him, and strips them from whomever He wills in His justice. He is not questioned about what He does, and He is indeed the All-Powerful, the Omnipotent.

**155** Today most of the people of the Bayán have been, and will remain, designated in the presence of God as worshippers of names. For had they recognized the Primal Point through His own Self and for His own sake, then, by God, they would not have hesitated for less than an instant before this Revelation of eternal holiness and this effulgence of merciful glory.

**156** It is thus clear that they had not recognized His own Self, glorious and mighty is He, but had recognized the garment of His name, exalted is His station. For only a few days passed before He appeared through His own Self and for His own sake, yet they failed to recognize Him and inflicted on Him what the Pen is ashamed to mention.

**157** This failure to recognize Him came about only because He changed His garment: that is, the name Most Exalted was changed to the name All-Glorious. No one recognized Him except those who detached themselves from everyone in the realm of creation and ascended to God with their whole being, until they entered an abode of noble glory. These are My loved ones beneath the shade of My loving care, and

**158** Tranquility descends upon them from Me, and they rest upon the couches of independence. These are the ones God has protected from the onslaught of doubts. They recline upon the cushions of holiness and gaze toward Me. Upon them at every moment be My glory, My mercy and loving care, My grace and bounty. Thus has God chosen them for My own Self and numbered them among the believers.

**159** O servants, strive, so that through the wondrous grace of the Lord of Lords you may enter beneath the shade of the canopies of the holy Sun of loving care, and remain sheltered and protected from the heat of self and desire. These are the counsels of the Pen of the Cause. Whoever listens does so for his own sake, and whoever turns away does so to his own detriment. He is indeed sanctified above all the worlds.

**160** If only the people of the Bayán would study the Persian Bayán, revealed by the Pen of the All-Merciful, so that they might not deprive themselves, in this Revelation of eternal holiness, of the Salsabíl of divine loving care and the Tasním of heavenly generosity. Doubts have so beset impure hearts that one thing cannot be distinguished from another; and if a heart is cleansed of doubt by the unfailing Kawthar of the everlasting Sovereign, it is immediately defiled by another doubt. Glory be to God! Although the people of the Bayán themselves acknowledge and confess that prophethood ended with the Messenger of God and that the year sixty marks the beginning of the Revelation of God, and although the True One is now visible in His own Self and Being, manifest and radiant from the horizon of “Indeed, I am living in the All-Glorious Horizon,” they nevertheless once again speak of successorship and the like. With the remnants of delusion left by the communities of the Qur’an, they have sought to veil the rays of the Sun of certitude that has risen in the heaven of the unfading holiness of the Lord of Majesty. It is fitting to cite these two couplets here.

**161** O Radiance of Truth, Sword of Religion and of the heart, O you before whose coming heart and soul are abashed! These clods of earth intend, out of envy, to conceal your sun.

**162** Set aside these fruitless sayings and turn your gaze to the source of the Cause and that through which the names were established. My previous Manifestation says, “Had people not been regarded as weak, I would assuredly not have mentioned the Will.” Now behold the sanctity of the Cause and the loftiness of what God has intended for you, and consider your own worth and rank: they have now resorted to the arguments of the lowliest servants among the people of the Qur’an and made these their proofs. Alas for you, O company of the heedless!

**163** In short, these are the days of Revelation, and the True One is manifest like the sun in the midst of heaven. There are no worldly riches in His holy court that He should need an executor to divide them. And if you say that He needs a successor in His Cause, this is an outrage on your part against God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting. For the Cause has always revolved, and will always revolve, around His own Self, and will never be separated from Him. Beware of assigning to God a minister, a peer, an adversary, a rival, a successor, a companion, or a likeness. In the Bayán He has effaced all these names and everything by which you have confined yourselves.

**164** Thus it is that mention of mirrors has been revealed in the Bayán by the All-Merciful, and this too has not been, and will not be, restricted. We hope that, from the showers of the heaven of sanctity, holy rains may be bestowed upon dusty, clouded hearts, so that they may be cleansed of allusions and turn toward the countenance of the Sovereign of names and attributes. By God, O people, My purpose in setting forth these conclusive proofs, these firm arguments, and these unambiguous words has not been to establish My own claim. For anyone endowed with even an immeasurably small degree of spiritual vision will assuredly behold the rays of the All-Glorious Sun, which has shone forth in all things in the form of “Indeed, there is no God but Me, the Almighty, the All-Wise.”

**165** Rather, My purpose concerns Him who will come in the Mustagháth. By God, at this My pen and My fingers weep, as do My eye, My heart, My liver, My veins, My blood, My bones, and My skin, over what will befall Him at the hands of those who have disbelieved in God, fought against His own Self, disputed His verses, denied His grace, and pronounced judgment against Him after He appeared with every verse, proof, and sign.

**166** By God, you have done what no one among the communities of the past has done, and committed that for which the Temple of Grandeur has torn the robe of patience. Yet you walk upon the earth like those who have committed no sin. Shame on you, O company of those who associate partners with God!

**167** By God, O people, falsehood has its odors, and truth likewise. If you would purify your hearts and your sense of smell and breathe deeply, you would surely perceive the fragrance of God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting. The Pen is bewildered as to what to mention. Matters have now reached such a point that the pure essence of spirit, which would find itself saddened even to be addressed by the most glorious words in all the worlds, must occupy itself with listening to the lowliest words:

**168** “How can a wolf become the shepherd of the sheep?” Say: O sightless, impoverished one! First, you have not recognized the Shepherd; and second, for years wolves have been your shepherds. For after the divine Luminary rose above the horizon of the spiritual heaven, you realized that you had been following a people to whom, in God’s sight, a wolf was a hundred thousand times preferable. For it was through the ruling of those wolves that the Manifestation of the Lord of Lords was martyred with utter cruelty. God’s curse be upon them and upon their followers.

**169** And if you say that before the Revelation following those people was the accepted practice and was acceptable to God, and that after the Revelation, because they hesitated in the Cause of God, they were numbered among the people of the fire, then apply the same judgment now in this Revelation of eternal holiness. Listen to the counsel of God and purify your hearts of the allusions in the words of those who are veiled. Say: O servants of desire, take a step toward God and soar from the land of conjecture into the air of certitude.

**170** O Pen of Eternity, leave aside for now what you intended to mention to the servants of God. Speak instead of your brother, who fought against your own Self and disputed the verses of God, that My account may be for all the worlds. Perhaps through it the eyes of those who have sought the Face at evening and at dawn may be opened, whose feet have not slipped on this Day when leg is entwined with leg.

**171** By Him in whose hand is My soul, for twenty years such strenuous efforts and such immense exertions were devoted to his instruction, discipline, upbringing, and protection that they cannot be recounted, until the departure took place and We arrived in this land. Some time passed. Siyyid Muḥammad-i-Iṣfahání left the House of God and the fortress of His love and settled elsewhere. And My brother—by God, besides whom there is no other god—set about cutting down the divine Lote-Tree, until God laid bare what was hidden within him, his scheming became known among the emigrants, and an outcry arose from every woman and man, young and old.

**172** This servant relinquished everything and withdrew, so that perhaps the heat of envy might cool and the fire of hatred subside. I took up residence alone in a house and closed the doors to everyone coming or going. All the members of the household, on hearing of this heinous affair, were occupied with lamentation and weeping. By God, no one will ever be able to recount what befell Us, nor will any of Our loved ones be able to bear hearing it.

**173** At the time of departure, three people were appointed to serve: two specifically for the aforementioned brother and Kalīm, and one for Myself. Likewise, the small sum received from the imperial government was divided among everyone. Then all dispersed and settled in various places, while this servant sat alone in the house, with the door closed and the curtain drawn. I personally associated with none of the friends or anyone else. The door of access was completely closed, and the Beauty of Eternity was concealed.

**174** After the Ancient Beauty withdrew into concealment, Siyyid Muḥammad joined My brother, and hatred of God became the cause and reason for their union. They occupied themselves with deceit and intrigue, even bribing someone with money to travel to the provinces and attribute to the Lote-Tree of the Cause what they themselves had committed. There is much more to recount, but I do not consider it fitting to occupy Myself with these matters. You have surely heard. Only as much as is necessary is disclosed, lest people be led by the words of these perishable liars to stray from the path of the Cause.

**175** Eventually, the person they had commissioned became remorseful, went to certain people, and related the details of these affairs. When they saw the correspondence he had been given to carry, they were all seized with astonishment, for everything those men had done they had attributed to the True One. They had also written a treatise refuting God, to be taken to various regions and circulated. By God, besides whom there is no other god, they have spoken like children—indeed, worse—if only you understood. Everything they imagined they had written in refutation of God has, in fact, affirmed this wondrous Cause, if only people would examine their words with the eye of God.

**176** How many other fabrications they have attributed to the Sovereign of names and attributes! Whatever was not good they have ascribed to the very root of the Tree of Lordship. “I complain of my anguish and sorrow only to God.” Then the Tongue of God speaks and says:

**177** “Is there any pure water to cleanse My surroundings of these people who turn away? Is there any sword of the tongue to conquer through utterance and ward off from My court the evil of those who associate partners with God? Is there anyone steadfast to help Me in these days when the deniers have surrounded Me? Is there anyone detached to know Me through My own eye and sever himself from all the worlds? Is there anyone with vision to examine My Cause and what has befallen Me from the hosts of devils? Is there anyone with a tender, pure heart to weep at My weeping and at what these arrogant ones have inflicted upon Me? Is there anyone with knowledge to turn the swords of rejection and hatred away from the face of God, the King, the Almighty, the Beautiful?”

**178** O Most Exalted Pen! Say: “By God, the True One, I sought help from no one when all the nations made war upon Me, and God is a witness to this and knows it well. Whenever He seeks help from anyone, and We enjoin this upon Our servants, it is solely that they may attain the summit of grace. Apart from this, God is indeed Self-Sufficient, Praiseworthy.”

**179** In short, they have written numerous treatises refuting the Sovereign of Oneness. By God, through this their deeds have come to nothing and their efforts have gone astray in this world and the next, yet they do not perceive it. They have attributed to this servant whatever they thought would cause people to turn away, including worldliness. Yet it was clear to every discerning person that this servant was as manifest and radiant as the sun amid those who turned away. I swear by the Ancient Beauty that no morning held any hope of living to see the night, nor did any night bring any expectation of witnessing the dawn, for those who associate partners with God were striving with all their might to cut down the Lote-Tree of the Lord of the worlds. At last the sun of the power of “The hand of God is above their hands” shone from the horizon of the bosom of grandeur, and those who associate partners with God were vanquished. The Beauty of “He is indeed supreme over all things” was established upon the throne of power and might and departed from Iraq with the utmost honor.

**180** It was known that My intention was to set out alone for Istanbul. When a number of people raised immeasurable cries of grief and distress, some were given permission to leave, while others set out without permission, until We arrived in the well-known land. No request whatsoever was made to the imperial government. Whoever came into My presence was received; otherwise, no meeting took place. Everyone has heard this, and in the Great City itself they also heard what the divine intention had been, until a few weak souls became anxious for their own safety and that of their wives and began to lament. Thus, out of compassion for them, a decree changing the former decree was revealed.

**181** Now, which of these matters had anything to do with the world? They have, in short, judged Me by themselves. Thus have their lying tongues described matters to them; they say what they do not comprehend. By God, besides whom there is no other god, the Pen is ashamed to mention what they have done. If anyone with discernment could be found, the standing and character of those who turn away would become apparent from these gentlemen’s treatises, which have issued from the pen of ignorance and hatred.

**182** Two years ago, Āqā Muḥammad ʿAlī and Salmān asked about a verse of poetry, and My brother wrote a reply. Siyyid Muḥammad-i-Iṣfahānī then came into My presence and said, “Mīrzā ʿAlī has not understood the meaning of the verse, and it is not advisable to give this letter to Salmān.” This servant remained silent. Later, together with Ḥājī Mīrzā Aḥmad, he raised the matter with My brother in Kalīm’s house. After some unhelpful remarks, My brother finally offered the excuse that perhaps the questioner had copied the original verse incorrectly.

**183** They then examined the verse: it had been copied correctly. That document is still in Salmān’s possession, and everyone has seen it. Yet no one has taken any notice, for all are veiled by imaginary notions. Now consider this, so that the worth of those who turn away may become known. Despite this, they object to the fountainhead and source of divine knowledge. By Him at whose threshold the kingdom of destiny stands, everything they have set down with their pens has been, and will be, of this same kind. But the veils of delusion and desire have blinded their eyes, and thus none take heed except those whose sight God has purified of veils; they look upon all things with keen vision.

**184** O servants! Consider how grievous the harm has become, that the Most Exalted Pen has occupied itself with these words. People are seen to be weak and immature, and it is feared that the fabricated words of those who turn away may cause them to become heedless of the Manifest Beauty. Otherwise, had even a little understanding and discernment been observed, no mention of those who turn away or of what has proceeded from them would ever have been written. For today everyone is obliged to look to the Cause itself and to what appears from its Source. Whoever ascends to that station will testify that He is the Manifest, the Resplendent, the Radiant, the Luminous in the midst of heaven. He ordains whatever He wills and is not questioned concerning what He desires. He is indeed the All-Powerful, the Unconstrained.

**185** Among other things, they have charged this wronged One with oppression. Now reflect on this very point and judge fairly. All the people of the Bayān have met this servant and seen Him with their own eyes. Has He ever consented to anyone being harmed? No, by the Lord of the throne, if you judge fairly! The very person of the All-Merciful was in the serpent’s mouth for twenty years, yet this was never disclosed. Even now, had these fabricated letters not been seen, it would never have been disclosed. Everyone who knows Me and possesses clear insight bears witness to this.

**186** For twenty years My brother was with this servant, and no one knew of him. Although I had power over him and knew what lay concealed within him and in his heart, he was treated with the utmost compassion. All things bear witness to this, if you would listen. But since they have found people to be blind followers without discernment, they have sought, through words of this kind, to keep this community from the Ocean of oceans.

**187** It is clear and evident to all the people of the Bayān and to others that this servant has associated with no one in this land, nor upon arriving in the Great City, except those who came into Our presence. My tongue moved only to speak what would raise them to the dominion of the Cause. Nevertheless, they have written, “He has called us Rāfiḍīs before the Sunnis.” By God, besides whom there is no other god, these very people who turn away have themselves accused the Lote-Tree of the All-Merciful of unbelief before the Persians and of Rāfiḍism before the Sunni community. Let someone now come, solely for God’s sake, and ascertain what is true and what is false. We make the truth or falsehood of this very statement the criterion of truth and error. Then the Tongue of Eternity calls out from His most great throne and says: “May God curse the first oppressor who wronged the Primal Point in His latter manifestation, denied His verses, made war upon His person, disputed His sovereignty, associated partners with His Essence, impugned His words, turned away from His beauty, and was numbered among those who associate partners with God, as inscribed by the Pen of holiness in the Tablets of God.”

**188** By God, whenever there was any talk in the Land of Ṭāʾ, in Iraq, or elsewhere of arresting this community, My brother himself would leave Iraq for other places, as most have heard and know. This servant remained alone among the enemies until, through divine power, the Cause was exalted. Once all felt secure for their own lives, they emerged from behind concealment, and the first task they undertook was to cut down the Lote-Tree of the Cause. When they saw themselves disappointed and defeated in what they had intended, they then wrote to various places, attributing their own intention to the will and purpose of God. Yet this servant abolished the injunction to kill, which had been widely known among this community. This has flowed from the Pen of God in most of the Tablets, and has certainly come to the attention of some.

**189** Among other things, a question was asked about what is meant by the assistance mentioned in the wondrous divine verses. What was sent down from the Throne in answer to it is reproduced here word for word, as follows:

**190** “The friends of God know what is meant by the assistance mentioned in the exalted Tablets: God, exalted be His mention, is sanctified above the world and all that is in it. Assistance has not meant that anyone should wage war or contend with another. The Sovereign of Glory has placed the whole earth, both land and sea, in the hands of kings, and they are the manifestations of divine power according to their respective ranks. If they enter beneath the shadow of God, they are accounted as belonging to Him; otherwise, your Lord is indeed all-knowing, all-informed.

**191** What God, exalted be His mention, has desired for Himself is the hearts of His servants, which are the treasuries of divine revelation and the repositories of divine love. It has always been the will of the everlasting Sovereign to purify hearts from the allusions of the world and all that is in it and upon it, so that they may become receptive to the lights of the revelations of the King of names and attributes.

**192** Thus no stranger must find a way into the city of the heart, so that the Friend may hasten to His own abode—that is, the revelation of His beauty, not His Essence and His very Self, for He has always been and will forever remain sanctified above ascent and descent. Assisting the Cause of God today has therefore never consisted, nor will it ever consist, in opposing anyone, disputing with anyone, or waging war against anything. Rather, what is desired is that the cities of hearts be conquered with the sword of the tongue and the wisdom of utterance, not with a sword of iron.

**193** Thus whoever wishes to assist God must first conquer the city of his own heart with the sword of inner meanings and utterance, purify it from all besides God, and then turn toward the cities of hearts. This is the assistance to the Cause of God that has shone forth today from the dawning-place of the finger of the King of names. Disorder has never been, and is not, acceptable, and whatever occurred in the past was without God’s permission.

**194** In short, today the friends of God must appear among His servants in such a manner that, through their deeds, they guide everyone to the Paradise of the Lord of Glory. I swear by the sun of the morning of sanctified glory that neither God nor His friends, who are associated with Him, have ever set their sights, or will ever set them, on the earth and its perishable possessions. For had the purpose been to take possession of the earth, He was assuredly powerful and mighty, and would have taken possession of the entire world with a single word.

**195** But He has bestowed sovereignty upon kings, wisdom upon the discerning, and spiritual knowledge upon those who recognize Him. He has reserved for Himself the love of His servants’ hearts, and has never sought, nor will He ever seek, anything else. This, too, is out of His supreme grace, that perhaps mortal souls may be cleansed and sanctified from earthly concerns and enter the abiding station, which is the Paradise of the glory of divine unity.

**196** Otherwise, that Sovereign of Eternity is, in Himself and for Himself, independent of all. No benefit accrues to Him from the love of created beings, nor does any harm befall Him from their harm. All emerge from earthly places and will return to Him, while that Beauty of Eternity remains, alone and unique, established upon His own seat, which is sanctified above place and time, mention and allusion, indication and description, height and nearness. None knows this except those endowed with discernment and insight.” End.

**197** Nevertheless, they have attributed to God, exalted be His station, deeds of which they themselves were the agents and perpetrators. Yet it is clear to all that God does whatever He wills and has power to carry out whatever He decrees, and no one has the right to object to Him. Even so, I swear by Him in whose hand is My soul that I have never consented to harm anyone, and the Pen of God bears witness to this, if you would bear witness. Among other things, they have stated in their letters that this servant has studied and that these revealed words are the product of acquired learning. Such unworthy statements have been made at the time of every revelation. They made this very allegation concerning My previous Manifestation, and before Him concerning Muḥammad, the Messenger of God: “A human being merely teaches Him.” “The tongue of the one to whom they allude is foreign, while this is a clear Arabic tongue.” Now let someone make inquiries throughout Iran and Iraq, so that truth and falsehood may become known. Woe to them for what they say!

**198** You who lack understanding! The source of this knowledge is the eternal Essence, and the wellspring of these words of wisdom is the most great Self of God, if only you perceived. If you listen with the ear of your innate nature, you will hear now the very same words that the learned and the ignorant of the age uttered in opposition to God at the appearance of the Point, exalted and glorified be He. By God, O people, I am bewildered by My plight and by what has befallen Me. If only My mother had not given birth to Me; or, if I had been born, had I never been nursed or grown to adulthood! But what has appeared has appeared, the hosts of revelation have been sent down, and the matter has been decreed by God, the One, the All-Subduing. O people, listen to My words, then tear through the veils, even if they should be the mirrors of the heavens and the earths. Beware lest anything keep you from the breezes of those days. By God, neither the treasures of creation nor the repositories of origination can equal them. God is witness to this and knows it well.

**199** I swear by the sun of the everlasting heaven that, had the matter been in this servant’s hands, not a single verse would have been recited among this people, for humanity has wholly departed from its original, divinely bestowed nature. But God has decreed what He desired and carried out what He willed. None can repel His will or reverse His decree, and He is wise in all things. Were it not that the people of this country were seen to be disturbed, permission would certainly have been given for everyone to appear in the presence of God, so that they might witness what no one in all the worlds has witnessed.

**200** Among other things, he has written that the station of being a sun falls under the shadow of the mirror, that this rank is above all stations, and that suns likewise shine forth from this mirror. Glorified be God! How ignorant he has assumed people to be! Yet it is perfectly clear and evident that the mirror was created and exists in order to reflect forms and likenesses. It is clear to everyone with sight that even the appearance within it of the reflections of likenesses and forms has never come about, nor does it come about, through the mirror itself and for its own sake. This point is evident to anyone born blind, let alone to someone with sight. Nevertheless, he has written in his epistles such statements as, by God, besides whom there is no other god, no ignorant person would utter. Through these words he has intended to deprive people of the One who brings names and attributes into existence and gives them reality. This is only because he has seen God’s servants submerged in the seas of delusion and desire, and has supposed that whatever he says will assuredly be accepted. Otherwise, he would not have occupied himself with these words, whose falsehood is more evident than the sun in the midst of heaven.

**201** He has also seized upon the fact that the Point of the Bayān—may the souls of all besides Him be sacrificed for Him—called Himself the Mirror of God in one passage, and has therefore claimed that the station of being a mirror is above that of being a sun. By Him who has caused Me to speak the truth and made Me shine from the horizon of holiness upon all the worlds, if anyone reflects on this one point, he will understand all the claims of this rabble. First, that eternal Essence has designated Himself by every name and described Himself by every attribute, from the highest degrees of names to the lowest. Thus, at the beginning of the Aḥsan al-Qaṣaṣ, He says—these are His words, exalted be His majesty—“Praise be to God, who has sent down the Book to His servant, that He may be a brightly shining lamp to all the worlds.” Can anyone now claim that the rank of a lamp is above that of the sun? No, by God! No one utters such words except someone who speaks from desire and wishes to cast doubt into pure and radiant hearts. How evil is what they do!

**202** In any case, know with certainty that in that court of holiness all names occupy a single plane. For when that eternal Being says, “I am the Lord of lords” and “I am the earth and the dust,” both have held, and will continue to hold, the same rank in that most great vista. Clouded hearts will not comprehend this most subtle, delicate, and pure utterance. Thus the Ancient Beauty says—exalted be His mention—“Say: I descended until I said, ‘I am a mote, and less than a mote,’ just as I said, ‘I am the Lord and the nurturer of all that has a lord.’ I will surely ask God’s forgiveness for both, and I am indeed among those who return to God, my Lord.” Thus ends the quotation.

**203** Now, you who journey in the valley of ignorance and error, you have drunk the cup of zaqqūm and deemed the Salsabīl of holiness sealed. You have burned in the fire of desire and counted yourselves among the inhabitants of the highest pavilion. What a pity that not for one moment have you reflected on the consummate wisdom of the All-Merciful, nor for a single instant turned with illumined sight toward the Cause of the Master of the Day of Judgment. You have so veiled with the veils of your own selves the words of the All-Merciful, revealed in perfect breadth and all-encompassing scope, without limits, that the tongues of all the worlds are powerless to describe it.

**204** Now consider this passage that has flowed from the holy Pen of God. He says, “I descended to the station where I say, ‘I am a mote, and less than a mote,’ just as I said, ‘I am the Lord and the nurturer of all lords.’ Rather, I ask forgiveness for both these statements.” Now consider how that Ancient Beauty has called Himself by every name. Can it nevertheless be said that the mote is above the sun, or the dust above the Lord of lords? Be fair, if you are among the fair-minded.

**205** By Him who has made Me the Manifestation of His Essence, His Being, His might, and His glory! If you reflect on these blessed divine words, the gates of limitless knowledge will open before your hearts, so that you will no longer be troubled because someone has been called by the names of God, or called the Essence of God and the Mirror of God. For all names are equal in that court, with no distinction between them, and all these names have revolved, and will continue to revolve, around the Manifestation of the eternal Self. For example, if at this moment the Ancient Beauty should designate a tree by all the most beautiful names and most exalted attributes, He assuredly has the power to do so, and no one has the right to object to Him, for He is the One who chooses, and all besides Him is within the grasp of His power. There is no god but Him, the Almighty, the All-Compelling.

**206** Furthermore, He has called all creation delicate mirrors, and says that if the attractions of divine love touch those mirrors, they draw them onward; but if anything other than love touches them, dust settles upon the very surface of those mirrors, coming between the mirror and recognition of the Cause of the almighty, all-knowing Lord. In His words—glorious and mighty is He—“Creation consists of delicate mirrors: if love touches them, it attracts; and if anything other than love touches them, dust settles upon their surface, surely coming between one and the Cause of his Lord.” Thus ends the quotation. Reflect, then, you heedless ones.

**207** The Point of the Bayān—exalted be His grandeur—made this statement in general terms. If, however, you are looking for a particular instance, He addresses Āqā Siyyid Javād in these words—mighty and glorious is He—“You are that Primal Mirror who has always reflected God and will forever reflect Him.” He has also called him the Primal Cause. By God, this rank is above all names, whether the Essence of God, the Being of God, the Remembrance of God, or the Mirror of God. For in the past, anyone who ascribed this rank to the Messenger of God was judged an unbeliever, since the Primal Cause was held to be God Himself.

**208** Likewise, these words were revealed concerning him—glorious be His mention—“We have made you a prophet over all the worlds.” Now, despite all these ranks and this description, above which nothing has been mentioned in the Bayān, should he—God forbid—turn away from God, all would be stripped from him in less than an instant. If you consider with illumined sight, He has called all things in the Bayān by all the most beautiful names, but none comprehend this except the sincere. These words are mentioned so that no one should suppose that the descriptions revealed in the Bayān were exclusive to one person rather than another. Rather, they hold true of all, as long as they remain beneath the shadow of God; once they leave it, all are deprived and debarred.

**209** Likewise, concerning the rank of Quddūs—may the soul of all the worlds be sacrificed for him—He says, exalted be His mention, “On his seat he was equal in number to eight vāḥids of the Mirror of God, and such was the intensity of the fire of his love that no one gained the power to draw near.” Thus ends the quotation. Now consider how He has mentioned eight vāḥids of the Mirror of God in his blessed person. Reflect, you people of insight. Treasures of knowledge lie hidden in this utterance, but this servant has not mentioned them, for fear of the Nimrod of oppression and the Pharaoh of ignorance.

**210** Likewise, in every instance it has been revealed by the Pen of Glory that the mirror has no reality in and for itself except through facing the sun. He has declared the sun to have always been, and forever to remain, one, and has designated no one by this name except the eternal Essence in every Revelation. Nevertheless, he has written that the station of being a sun is beneath the rank of being a mirror, and that suns rise from the mirror. By God, O people, I do not speak from desire! If you reflect on this statement alone, you will assuredly testify that these assertions have arisen from sheer ignorance and unalloyed hatred.

**211** I adjure you, O people, by God who created and fashioned you, to consider the beginning of the Persian Bayān, where He says—exalted be His mention—“If the mirror says, ‘The sun is within me,’ it is evident to the sun that it is its image of which the mirror speaks.” Thus ends the quotation. Nevertheless, he has written that the mirror is above the sun and that the suns are beneath the mirror’s shadow. If by these suns he has mentioned he means the Suns of Truth, exalted is He above that! For through a single effulgence among the effulgences of the Sun of Truth, a hundred thousand mirrors are raised up in less than an instant.

**212** Besides this, the mirror was created so that an effulgence among the sun’s effulgences might be imprinted upon it, if it is clear; otherwise it is judged to be a stone. For it is evident to everyone with sight that mirrors were created to receive the reflections of things, as has been mentioned. If, however, he meant the suns of names and anything below them, this is not exclusive to any one person, for these suns exist in all and appear from each at the time God has ordained for them. Whoever opens the eye of his heart beholds a sun in every mote, then a sun within this sun, then a sun within the sun of that sun, without end. Yet the wisdom of God has left this station unmentioned, lest the feet of those endowed with spiritual knowledge should slip.

**213** For God’s sake, O people, consider this injustice inflicted upon the Ancient Beauty by one who prides himself on standing in His presence! Yet when his name became well known, he disbelieved in God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting. And since My previous Manifestation knew that the mirror would claim to be the sun in the following Revelation, this pronouncement issued from the Pen of Glory.

**214** He has become so submerged in the ocean of pride and arrogance that he has seized upon My former words concerning the loftiness of his station, yet turned away from their source, their wellspring, their manifestation, their originator, and the One who revealed them. Away, then, with the people of wrongdoing! He has likewise called himself the Tree of Grandeur. By God, all these words are due to his having found the people foolish.

**215** And if he is reckoned a tree in God’s sight, he is among the trees that should be cut down and cast into the fire, unless he repents to God, seeks forgiveness for what he has done, and becomes one of the repentant. It is clear to everyone—both those who have migrated to this land and every discerning person who considers affairs with the eye of God—that these arrogant words have flowed from that false, lying, idolatrous tongue only because he has seen this wondrous, most marvelous, most exalted Sun rising from the horizon of the dawn of eternity and proclaiming between earth and heaven the melody, “I am indeed alive in the all-glorious horizon.” He has therefore made haste and, without realizing it, uttered these words to establish for himself a station above the station of God.

**216** This can never be possible, for everything other than Him is created by His command, brought into being by His will, and set in motion by His permission. All that comes after Him is but His servant, His subject, His creation, His creature, and His servants. Is there any station above the station of God that anyone might claim for himself? He stands by Himself, for Himself, in the loftiness of His own Self, in a station that has no above or below, no right or left, no front or back. By His will He created the directions, not from any direction, and by His purpose He created all things, not from any pattern. He is indeed the Creator of every station and the Revealer of every command. It befits those other than Him to glory in His own Self, while He glories in none of the beings in existence. He is indeed the Holy, the Transcendent, the All-Powerful, the One who is obeyed.

**217** O people, hear My call, and do not inflict upon My Beauty what you have been forbidden to do in all the Tablets. By God, this is the outstretched hand of divine power that has encompassed all who are in the heavens and on earth. This is the tongue of divine truth that sings upon the loftiest Tree of the glory of oneness. This is the Pen of Eternity from which oceans of divine mysteries and knowledge flow and stream by day and by night. This is the treasury of the pearls of consummate wisdom and the mine of divine knowledge, which has always bestowed its bounty and will continue to do so forever. Beware lest you deprive yourselves of the sprinklings of its grace, and do not consider it obligatory to follow every sightless soul.

**218** He has likewise stated in his treatise that merely by knowing a few words and understanding some phrases, He has made these claims. By these absurd words he meant this sacred, eternal Temple. By Him who is peerless in power and might, throughout the nights and days, just as teachers teach children the letters of the alphabet, strenuous efforts were devoted to teaching him. If only My people knew how limited his capacity, how lowly his station, how abundant his conceit, and how grandiose his speech! This is clear and evident to every discerning person and has never required, nor does it now require, a detailed account.

**219** Among other things, he has alleged that this servant has spoken disrespectfully of the Primal Point, whereas this servant proclaims between the heavens and the earth, “I am indeed His very Self, His Essence, His Spirit, His Temple, and His Glory.” How, then, could I speak of that most exalted Essence and most glorious Reality—may the spirit of everyone in the realms of eternity be sacrificed for Him—in a manner contrary to God’s good pleasure? In short, this is exactly like the people of the Qur’an who, at the first dawn of the Revelation, alleged that this community had no love for the Messenger of God, hoping through such absurdities to deprive God’s servants of recognizing His own Self on the Day of Return, as they have done and continue to do. Indeed, God’s curse be upon those who fabricate falsehoods.

**220** Although wondrous writings have encompassed the whole world, and all the people of the Bayán bear witness and testify to this; although the equivalent of what was revealed in the Bayán has descended from this wondrous Revelation, and there is not one among the people of the Bayán who does not possess a writing of God; and although, beyond this, the scribes have been unable to transcribe what exists in this land, so that most of it remains uncopied—nevertheless, he has written that merely through understanding phrases and knowing a few words, He has made these claims. Now judge fairly: with what audacity and impudence he has uttered a statement whose falsehood is as manifest, apparent, and clear as the sun in the midst of heaven!

**221** Yet, by God, besides whom there is no god, this servant has never intended that what is newly revealed from the heaven of the divine will should become widely known throughout the lands, for very few purified eyes are to be found that are worthy of beholding the writings of God. Therefore I have always kept them concealed. How many verses of God were revealed in Iraq, all of which were effaced in the river! And now the equivalent of a hundred thousand verses exists in this land, not yet transcribed, let alone bound into volumes. For this servant has always been, and will always remain, sanctified from such matters as pertain to self-display.
