**222** Several times, some have wished to bind what exists into volumes and send them abroad, but permission has not yet been given, for none of the Manifestations of God has personally undertaken such matters. Thus the Primal Point—may the spirit of all besides Him be sacrificed for Him—did not Himself attend to these matters, but said that they should later be arranged in the finest order. He says—exalted be His mention—“Blessed is the one who beholds the order of Bahá’u’lláh and gives thanks to his Lord, for He will assuredly appear, and there is no averting Him, as ordained by God in the Bayán.” Here ends the quotation. Likewise, in the past, with the Messenger of God: the Qur’an was bound into a volume after that eternal Being’s ascension, and before Him, the Gospel.

**223** Although the verses of holy glory have encompassed the east and west of the world, they have seized upon these words and described them as a mere handful of words. Thus, in the past year, several sets of pilgrimage rites issued from the Pen of Glory, yet none was sent out except one surah, known as the Surah of Pilgrimage. This servant has never spent time publicizing such matters, nor will He ever do so. Revelation is the province of God, and dissemination is the province of His creatures. He will indeed spread His Cause through the hands of those angels brought near to Him who disseminate it. Spiritual servants will assuredly emerge from behind the tabernacle of divine protection, gather the writings of God, and arrange them in the finest order. This is an irrevocable decree, beyond all doubt.

**224** Furthermore, they have written certain statements and attributed them to the Point of the Bayán—may the spirit of all besides Him be sacrificed for Him. This is a blatant lie. The Point of the Bayán therefore disavows them and their words, and God bears witness to this, even if you do not.

**225** How greatly they pride themselves on names! By God, besides whom there is no god, the like of these souls has never been seen in all creation. They spend their days and nights seeking a word in the Book of God that they might interpret as referring to themselves. When I, this servant, parted from My brother, I sent him a box of calligraphic writings, circles, and temples in the handwriting of the Primal Point, with this message: “Since you are so eager, after turning away from the Truth, to pride yourself on His writings, these have been sent to you so that you may send these temples to some of the people in different lands and display your station, or distribute them to whoever comes into your presence, as indeed you are occupied in doing today. You have even added some of your own fabricated words to those words, in the hope that through them the feet of those who have attained recognition might slip.”

**226** In short, O servants, turn your eyes away from these matters and sanctify your hearts, for today such grace has appeared that in a single day and night, if a scribe can keep pace, the equivalent of the Persian Bayán descends from the heaven of divine holiness. The same is true of verses in a wondrous Arabic tongue. Come, then, before the Throne, that you may witness with your own eyes. Do not measure the words of God against the words of anyone besides Him, and possess an illumined insight.

**227** O people, bear witness to that to which God has borne witness, do not turn toward anyone besides Him, and do not be among the doubters. God bears witness that there is no god but Him, and that the Primal Point is His servant and His glory. Thus was it revealed before by the Pen of God, the Most High, the Most Great.

**228** Had you grasped the full meaning of this one verse, you would never have been veiled from the most great path of God. Yet today most of the people of the Bayán bear witness, but when they reach this blessed Name, their faces darken, their hearts are troubled, their feet slip, and they become those who hesitate.

**229** By God, the True One, no deed is accepted before God without acknowledgment of this blessed, sanctified Name. Blessed, then, are those who remember and those who stand firm.

**230** Furthermore, he has boasted in his treatises that Ṭáhirih and ʿAẓím acknowledged him. Yet I, this servant, regard pride in such matters as sheer nothingness and utter nonexistence. This is not out of conceit or arrogance, for this servant has never seen, nor will ever see, any station in Himself. Rather, this has been mentioned to manifest the station of God, for the very beings of the Letters, in their origin and entirety, have been, and will be, called into being by a single utterance.

**231** It is not fitting for the True One to establish His manifestation by adducing anything other than Himself and what proceeds from Him, for every proof has been and will remain sound through its connection to Him, and every path is straight through its relation to Him. Yet since people are seen to be weak and immature, I, this servant, mention that the divine words revealed specifically concerning this Cause have been, and will remain, beyond the reckoning of these souls.

**232** If people were to look with the eye of God, this single utterance of the Point of the Bayān—exalted be His praise—would suffice them all: “Indeed, I am alive in the horizon of the All-Glorious.” Thus today He is manifest, radiant, and shining from the horizon of the All-Glorious, and He now hears and sees everything that all created beings say and do. Besides this,

**233** The testimony He has mentioned in the Tablets, which He has commanded everyone to recite, is a clear proof for anyone who looks with the eye of God, his Lord. His words—exalted is He—are: “God bears witness that there is no god but Him, and that the Primal Point is His servant and His glory.” These verses are a clear proof and a decisive demonstration, yet they “increase the deluded in nothing but loss,” for the deluded have interpreted all the verses according to their own imaginings. He also says—exalted be His remembrance: “Indeed, I am the throne of glory in the greatest truth. I have been above the dawning-place of His flowing ruby, above the Mount.”

**234** If you reflect on His intent in this blessed, revealed verse, you will become aware of the loftiness of this most exalted, most inaccessible, most holy Revelation. He also says—exalted be His station: “God has indeed created around that Gate seas of the water of the elixir, reddened by the oil of existence and made living by the intended fruit. God has ordained for it ships of His moist crimson ruby, and none but the people of Bahāʾ embark in them, by the permission of God, the Most High. He is God, ever mighty and wise.”

**235** Now the ships of moist crimson ruby sail and glide upon the ocean of majesty. O people of Bahā, detach yourselves from everything but God, enter the ark of oneness and the vessel of everlasting glory, and embark. For every soul who clings to this ark is reckoned before God among the people of affirmation and salvation, of the highest heaven and paradise; and whoever stays behind is counted among the people of fire and destruction, of the nethermost prison and the abyss.

**236** Take care not to exchange your faith for the world, nor trade the Joseph of the glory of oneness for the bounties of this world and the next. Before long, you will see all that is visible vanish. Hasten, then, with the utmost effort and endeavor to the shelter of the Lord of creation, for there has never been, nor will there ever be, a safe refuge other than His shelter.

**237** And His words—exalted be His majesty: “As for the youth, he is of the fire of the green tree, kindled from this yellow spring. We killed him in the visible temple because of what God had ordained in the Book as a portion from his parents, for We feared that, amid the fire, he would burden them with rebellion against the Beauty of Bahāʾ, without knowledge.”

**238** Now it is abundantly clear that all have rebelled against this most manifest, most luminous, all-glorious Beauty to a degree that no one can reckon except through the knowledge of God. If only they had been content with rebellion and arrogance! Rather, at every moment they have been, and will continue to be, occupied with destroying the house of God and His sanctuary. Their hearts will never be stilled except by drinking My blood, after We created and protected them for the exaltation of My Cause and the aid of My Beauty.

**239** When He had strengthened them and they felt assured of themselves, they rose up to kill Me in grievous rebellion. When I reached this point, the Herald called from behind the tabernacle of eternity: “O Most Exalted Pen, do not confine Your Cause to mentioning one thing rather than another. Say: By God, the entire Bayān was revealed for My wondrous, inaccessible Cause. But for You, not a letter of the Bayān would have been revealed, nor any scrolls of noble glory. Leave the dead, for those who have not believed in You are dead, not living. They neither hear nor understand, even if the words of the first and the last are recited to them. Those whom God has brought to life through You have, in their love for You, read all the Books, and they will never need anything but You, for God has made Your manifestation itself a proof to all the worlds.”

**240** When I heard the call, I contented Myself with what had been inscribed by a luminous finger of holiness.

**241** In short, the verses of the glory of oneness concerning this Name and Revelation are beyond counting. Yet these ignorant rabble have interpreted this blessed Name as referring to the land of Ṭā, because the Most Exalted One—may the soul of all else be sacrificed for Him—called it the land of Bahā.

**242** They have lacked even the understanding to perceive that His purpose was to foretell the appearance of the holy Beauty in that land—that is, a land upon which Bahāʾ walks and in which this radiant, luminous Name has dwelt. Thus He has mentioned this blessed Name as preceding all names in every degree, and

**243** likewise, consider the earlier prayer, in which this blessed Name is mentioned as the foremost of the names, in His words: “O God, I ask You by the most glorious of Your glory.” Likewise, among the months to which He has given new names, He has associated the first with this Name. Whatever you examine, He has designated its finest part by this Name.

**244** Yet consider how far their hatred has gone: they have interpreted this blessed Name as referring to a land, a speck of whose dust is better than they are, than their very selves and realities. Shame on them and on the fire of envy and hatred within their breasts! They burn in it at every moment, yet do not perceive it.

**245** Furthermore, his honor Quddūs—exalted be his praise—wrote and sent several Tablets in the land of Badasht, which this servant has never disclosed. Among other things, he foretold this wondrous Cause explicitly, without allusion. His words—exalted be his praise—are: “When the Lord manifests a secret from the horizon of Bahāʾ in the land of ‘or nearer,’ that resplendent Countenance from the point of the letter Bāʾ has indeed been an exemplar. And when the heavens of attraction are raised through the line, through the mystery of the line, that has indeed been a harbinger of Our Cause to the people of the cloud of unknowing.” Those blessed Tablets are now extant, and all bear witness and testify to this Cause in the most explicit words. By the Lord of the Throne and the cloud of unknowing, shame prevents Me from mentioning these words, for this servant has never wished to establish a station for Himself through earlier utterances. For My station is His station, and it is manifest in the midmost heaven of independence. There is no one endowed with sight who does not witness and behold it, while the blind have no share in it.

**246** Say: By God, My station is His station, My power is His power, and My sovereignty is His sovereignty. His manifestation is My proof, and what has flowed from His Pen is My testimony, just as My manifestation is His proof, and what has flowed from My Pen is His testimony. Yet this is being written for the protection of immature servants.

**247** Among them, too, was the Point of Attraction, her honor Ṭā—upon her be the glory of God, the All-Glorious—who was with this servant for a long time. She would not have exchanged a moment in the presence of this Youth for dominion over this world and the next, nor did she wish to part from Me for less than an instant. Yet what was decreed came to pass. How many verses and poems she uttered concerning this wondrous Cause! Among them, she composed a ghazal in praise of the divine Countenance, one couplet of which is this:

**248** Should Bahā cast the veil from His face, a hundred thousand like Azal would appear.

**249** She likewise offered much praise concerning others besides this servant. Above all these utterances stands the Hidden Book of the Most Exalted Point—may the soul of all else be sacrificed for Him—which was revealed entirely concerning this wondrous Cause and has been concealed from view. Ask God that you may attain it.

**250** By Him in whose hand is My soul, had the one laying claim to the divine Beauty not cited such proofs in his book today and clung to them, thereby making these arguments a means of leading people astray, this servant would never have adduced these proofs. In short, O servants, hear the call of the Most Exalted ʿAlī in His latter manifestation, and erase all these proofs from your hearts. For if you cling to words, allusions, scrolls, and books in this wondrous divine Revelation, you will never attain the essence of the recognition of the Countenance of the All-Merciful and the Sovereign of all existence.

**251** Rather, look to that very proof which the Primal Point Himself—glorified and exalted be He—brought forth and by which He established His Cause, as did before Him that Ancient Beauty, Muḥammad, the Messenger of God, and before Him the Son of Mary, and before Him Moses. By Him in whose hand is My soul, a single letter of the verses of God is dearer to this servant than all who are in the heavens and on earth.

**252** As for the statement that, at the time of the Revelation, you should not look to words, allusions, indications, names, and attributes: this is a command given by the Primal Point Himself—may the soul of all else be sacrificed for Him. The intention of that divine Beauty was that, at the time of the Revelation, the people of the Bayān should not, like the people of the Qurʾān, cling to traditions and verses and object to the One who manifests them, brings them into being, and reveals them.

**253** In short, if you reflect a little on this most wondrous, most exalted Revelation, you will become acquainted with countless mysteries and see that, from the beginning of creation until now, no such Revelation has appeared. Yet, in view of the servants’ lack of readiness, obstacles are also present, so that through this He may separate the substance from the accident and the spirit from the clay.

**254** By God, the True One! Today, if a particle of a gem were mixed with a hundred thousand maunds of stone and concealed beyond seven seas, the hand of divine power would assuredly bring it to light and separate that particle of the gem from the stone. O people, the breeze of God is blowing, the Spirit of God is stirring, and the attraction of God is dawning from the horizon of the dayspring of the Beauty of the All-Merciful.

**255** Raise your heads from the sleep of self and desire, and behold what has appeared in creation. Beware of lending an ear to the people’s idle words, for today, if a pure ear is found, it will hear from this group what it used to hear from the people of the Qurʾān and what it heard from the people of the Torah and the Gospel. Indeed, beyond words, it will witness with both outward and inward sight the very same deeds.

**256** Thus today, the one who has waged war against the True One Himself and arrogantly defied Him who created him has stated in his writings: “If the True One appears, whether from among the people of the Bayān or others, whether slave or free, black or white, this servant is obedient; I have no objection.” Now consider that he says this at the very time he is engaged in warfare against the Beauty of God and has turned away in utter rejection. Now reflect and consider what the proof of the True One has been and what the sign of His appearance is.

**257** He turns away from this Revelation, so plainly manifest that its light has encompassed the world, and has risen to put Him to death; then he occupies himself with these words to delude the people. It was the same at the beginning of the Revelation, when the divines of the Qurʾān, prayer beads in hand, were occupied with worship in their temples in the utmost humility and reverence. They made such a display of piety that, whenever the name of the True One was mentioned, they would rise and bow with the utmost humility. Yet in that very state of humility and submission, they issued decrees for His death and pronounced Him an unbeliever, while saying: “How could we turn away from the True One, when by night we have awaited Him with hope and by day we beseech Him? Whenever He appears, we are obedient and submissive.”

**258** Now the one who turns away from God—by God, besides whom there is no other god—severs the head of the Manifestation of the True One Himself with the knife of iniquity and indecency and the sword of malice and hatred, while at that very moment, with bowed head, he utters these words: “Whenever the True One appears, I am obedient.”

**259** By God, O people, he has found you immature, and so he speaks such nonsense. He has found you so deluded that he has decreed the death of the True One who has appeared with every manifestation, and is at all times engaged in warfare against His Beauty, yet still speaks these words. Alas, and woe to you, that you have remained heedless of Him who is more manifest than every manifestation and have occupied yourselves with one from whom—by God—if you knew him, you would flee a thousand stages.

**260** And We ask God to separate Me from him and to cleanse the land on which I dwell of the defilement of these transgressors, or to settle Me in another land. He is indeed bountiful to His servants, and He has power over all things.

**261** Say: O ignorant one, the Beloved Himself is manifest and shines like the sun, yet today you have not attained recognition of Him. Rather, despite all the proofs and testimonies that have encompassed the world, you do not count Him among the faithful. Nevertheless, you cling to His words, seeking to establish leadership for yourself. By God, the True One, all things then declare you false, but you do not perceive it. In God’s sight, you are like the people of the Qurʾān, who have established their leadership through the words of the Messenger and sit upon thrones of honor and authority, yet have inflicted on His very person what no eye in creation has ever seen or perceived. O you who are drunk with the wine of self and desire! You have turned your eyes from the manifest Sovereign and clung to your own imagined one. This abasement alone is enough for you: you have denied the verses by which your religion was established, in which you take pride, and through which you claim a station for yourself.

**262** Yet you remain unaware. Thus your station in God’s sight is no different from that of those who turned away after believing and denied after acknowledging, if you are among those who understand. By God, the True One, the Faithful Spirit has bared His head because of your deed, yet you have not perceived it and remain among the heedless. The maidens of the heavenly chambers have sat upon ashes because of your injustice, while within yourself you rejoice.

**263** By God, the True One, everything laments and weeps within itself, but you have remained heedless and are among those who turn away. You are the one who mentions the Beloved with your tongue to mislead the people, while killing the Beloved of the first and the last. If God were to open your eyes, you would see that through your injustice the Beloved has been suspended in the air, and that at every moment you assail Him with the projectiles of envy and hatred, then with the arrows of malice and obstinacy, then with the bullets of rejection. God is indeed a witness to this and knows it.

**264** Thus Muḥammad laments in the highest horizon, and the Spirit weeps in the all-glorious company, as does Moses beside the Lote Tree beyond which none may pass, and the eyes of the Prophets and Messengers shed tears. O you who are drunk with the wine of pride! Come to your senses for less than a moment; reflect on yourself and your deeds.

**265** Suppose you have obscured the Cause of God for this immature group, and all of them have bowed down to you instead of God. What benefit do you gain? No, by the Lord of the worlds! It has yielded and yields nothing but loss in this world and the next. Even if today you sit upon a throne of ruby, in God’s sight you dwell on the ground of the abyss.

**266** By God, if you listen with the ear of your inborn nature, you will hear the very ground on which you sit seeking refuge in God from you and saying: “O heedless one, by what proof and evidence do you establish your own right while denying the right of Him to whom all right belongs and through whom truth has been established? Shame on you and on those who have taken you as their beloved instead of God!” You did not become certain of the True One; why, then, did you rise to put Him to death?

**267** After all, for twenty years He strove to protect you, although He knew what was in your heart. Had He so willed for an instant, you would not have existed. Yet you did not take heed, and throughout the world you have attributed your own deed to the True One. By God, nothing is in this heart but the lights of the effulgences of the dawn of eternity, and it is not willing that any soul should suffer harm \[corrupted original text\]

**268** O My brother, hear the call of this One who, through your injustice, has fallen into this bottomless well, whose shirt has been spattered with true blood through your malice. From the depths of the well He calls out and says: “O My brother, do not do to your brother what the son of Adam did to his brother. O My brother, fear God. Do not dispute My verses, do not wage war against My person, and do not kill the One who made His breast a target for the swords of His enemies so that no harm might come to you, and who protected you through every night and day, every morning and evening.”

**269** O My brother, by God, the True One, I do not speak from desire. This is nothing but revelation revealed. One mighty in spirit taught Me at the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary. By God, O My brother, it is not of My own devising, but comes from One who is Almighty, All-Wise. Whenever I turned toward you to prevent you from stirring up a turmoil by which the servants would be put to the test, and to safeguard the Cause of your Lord, by God, you hurled the shafts of discord at Me. And whenever I drew near to you so that your soul might thereby find peace, you rose against Me in hypocrisy. Your own limbs bear witness to this, if you should deny it.

**270** By God, O My brother, whenever I remained silent about the wonders of the remembrance of My Lord, the Holy Spirit raised Me up for His Cause, and the Most Great Spirit awakened Me from My slumber and made Me speak the truth between the heavens and the earths. If this is My sin, I am not the first to have sinned: those who came before Me committed it, as did the One who was named ʿAlī in the kingdom of names, then Muḥammad in the uttermost dominion, then My Son in the Concourse on High, then the One who conversed with God upon this holy, blessed, mighty, exalted Sinai.

**271** O My brother, look into the books of the Prophets and Messengers, and then into the proofs of God, His testimony, His evidences, His traces, His manifestations, and His signs that are in their hands. Then judge your brother fairly, and do not be among those who wronged the very Self of God and then claimed to have been wronged, so as to instill doubt and misgiving in the hearts of the believers.

**272** By God, when your brother realized that you had risen against Him and that the fire of envy in your breast would not subside, He left on His own with His family, entered another house, shut its door against His own coming and going, and remained there. Yet even then, O My brother, you found no peace within yourself: you wrote what you wrote and sent what you sent. By God, the Pen is ashamed to set down what you have said and the accusations you have fabricated against your brother. By God, through this you have violated My honor and the honor of God among His servants. You will soon witness and see, even though you are now among the heedless.

**273** Rise, then, from the slumber of self and desire, trim the mustache of envy, and clip the nails of hatred. Then perfume yourself with the fragrance of faithfulness, wash with the waters of holiness, and lay your face upon the dust in submission, humility, repentance, and return.

**274** Beloved. And say: “O Lord, I am the one who failed in my duty toward my brother throughout the nights and days and was heedless of the wonders of Your wise remembrance. Now, O my God, lift the veil from my sight, so that I may recognize Your Self, arise to praise You, detach myself from everything but You, and turn toward Your generous face. Then make me one of those servants of Yours for whom You have appointed a seat of truth in Your presence, and grant me sustenance from the heavenly spring of Your care and the river of Your bounty.

**275** Then join me to Your sincere servants, who paid no heed to the world, its positions of authority, or anything within it or upon it, who detached themselves and their possessions in the path of their Maker and were among the detached. O Lord, do not leave me to myself. Take my hand in the hand of Your power, and rescue me from the engulfing depths of self and desire, their blaze and their burning. Then make that fire coolness and peace for me, and a spirit of life and sweet fragrance, and number me among Your detached servants.

**276** O Lord, enable me to serve You and convey Your verses. Make me a helper of Your Cause, a guardian of Your religion, one who voices Your praise and proclaims the wonders of Your bounty and generosity. You indeed have power over whatever You will, and You are the Almighty, the Generous. O Lord, do not disappoint anyone who has grasped the cord of Your care, and do not drive away anyone who has hooked the finger of hope upon the cord of Your generosity and bounty.

**277** O Lord, do not veil me from the wellspring of Your good pleasure. Make me content to acknowledge what You have approved and sent down from the clouds of Your grace and the clouds of Your glorious generosity. You are the Bestower in every circumstance, and You are the All-Forgiving, the Merciful. O Lord, do not strip my body of the shirt of fairness, or my heart of the robe of acknowledgment of Your Self, the All-Merciful, the Merciful.

**278** O Lord, make my foot firm upon Your path, so that I may not deny that to which You have summoned me in all Your verses, Your tablets, Your scriptures, Your books, Your volumes, and the pages of Your unassailable holiness. O Lord, make me look toward Your gifts and return to the ocean of Your forgiveness. Do not strip me of the beauty of praising You. You indeed have power over whatever You will, and You are mighty to do whatever You desire.

**279** Strengthen me so that I may not deny that through which my faith was made real, my remembrance established, my name exalted, my being brought to life, and my reality brought into existence, and through which I became one of the believers. O Lord, do not deprive the one who has stood before the city of Your mercy and clung to the hem of Your kindness and grace. O Lord, appoint for me a word from Your presence, so that through it I may remain mindful in the evening, at daybreak, and at every moment.”

**280** Thus does the tongue of the Wronged One in the depths of the pit give you words to speak, so that you may find a path toward fairness. God now addresses His holy breeze, which blows from the direction of the Throne, and has made it a messenger from His presence to the worlds, for in these days He will find no messenger to send to His servants with the glad tidings of His Cause and to make them among those who remember and rejoice. For He has fallen into a prison beyond the reach of the hands of His devotees and the feet of those who seek Him. Beyond this imprisonment, He has fallen into the well of envy, whose depths none knows but His own Self, the All-Reckoning, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed. Thus has God recounted a true account through His truthful, speaking, all-knowing, faithful Tongue.

**281** O morning breeze, since no messenger is to be found, pass from the Riḍván of eternity, bearing the fragrance of the shirt of Bahá, among the devoted ones of My loved ones. Acquaint them all with the clear evidences of the spirit and the signs of revelation, so that perhaps some souls may become pure and sanctified from all who dwell on earth and from attachment to it, and return to the Most Great Paradise. But, O breeze, pass with complete detachment, so that if the harm of all the worlds should assail you, you would remain patient, and if their blessings should descend upon you, you would pay no heed. For unless you become sanctified from the envy and hatred, rejection and acceptance, calm and agitation of all who dwell on earth, you will neither be capable of this exalted proclamation nor attain the privilege of bearing divine mysteries. Thus does the tongue of your Lord command you, so that you may be among those who act.

**282** Say: O loved ones, O people of understanding! At last, free your gaze to some degree from attention to the world and its affairs. With the eye of insight, consider and reflect upon the manifest events and radiant signs that have appeared and become evident from the direction of the All-Glorious Throne. Perhaps, in these days when the intoxication of heedlessness has overtaken all the inhabitants of heaven and earth, you may bring yourselves to the city of God's eternal oneness and not remain deprived of the wonders of His unfailing mercy. Otherwise—God forbid—you may be veiled from the primary purpose of the All-Merciful and be reckoned in the Book of the Lord of Lords among those who turn away, without being aware of it. We seek refuge in God from this, O people of understanding!

**283** All the Prophets and Messengers have summoned humanity to the paths of recognition of the Beauty of the All-Merciful, for this has been and will remain the greatest of all stations. Reflect a little on the sending of the divine Messengers: for what cause and purpose have these Temples of Oneness come from the unseen into the realm of the visible, and endured all the afflictions and calamities of which you have heard? There is no doubt that their purpose has been, and will remain, nothing but to summon the servants to recognition of the Beauty of the All-Merciful. If you say that the purpose was His commandments and prohibitions, there is no doubt that this has not been, and will not be, the primary purpose. For if someone were to perform the worship of all the inhabitants of heaven and earth yet remain deprived of the recognition of God, it would never have benefited, nor will it ever benefit, those who perform it. This matter is evident and clear in all the heavenly books. And if a soul recognizes the True One but abandons all the divine commandments, there is hope of salvation, as is clear and manifest to those endowed with insight.

**284** Thus the primary purpose of bringing creation into being, of the appearance of originated things, of sending Messengers, of revealing books, and of the Messengers' bearing countless hardships has, in every case, been recognition of the Beauty of the All-Glorious. Now, therefore, if a soul should engage in every deed and spend an entire lifetime in standing and sitting, remembrance and contemplation, and other such acts, yet remain deprived of the recognition of God, no fruit will ever accrue to that soul. And recognition of God has always meant recognition of the Manifestation of His own Self among His creatures, as set forth in all the books, especially in the Bayán, in all of whose tablets this lofty and most exalted theme, this most precious and sublime truth, has been stated and demonstrated. Blessed, then, are those who recognize.

**285** If viewed with the purest sight, it becomes evident that all the Temples of Oneness who have sacrificed life and possessions, reputation and name in the path of the Beloved have had no primary purpose except to draw the servants to the waters of recognition. Now consider the Prophets: how many countless afflictions they have borne so that people might tear through the veils of illusion and drink from the river of certainty.

**286** Since the thick veils of illusion loomed so large and held such sway in people's eyes, whenever a Messenger appeared from God, all rose in opposition to that divine Breeze, until the succession of Messengers culminated in the Guide of the paths in the year sixty. It became evident how far people had remained from the sacred shore of certainty through their own vain imaginings, to such a degree that among them nothing was spoken of as God but desire, and nothing as certainty but manifest conjecture.

**287** When the most exalted Beauty of ʿAlī commanded that the veils be torn away, all rose to turn away from Him, until a small number recognized the essential purpose and, burning away all the veils of illusion and the splendors of conjecture with the fire of the divine Tree, attained recognition of the Beauty of the All-Merciful. By God, the True One! If anyone were to reflect on what befell that blessed Beauty—the rejection of the religious scholars and countless afflictions—that person would spend an entire lifetime lamenting, mourning, and weeping. At last, the people of malice suspended that manifest Beauty in the air and, with the bullets of idolatry and hatred, cut down that Tree of utmost glory.

**288** While that blessed Beauty was suspended in the air, in the innermost mystery He spoke these firm and weighty words with an eloquent and lucid tongue: “People of the Bayān, reflect a little on these people. They all consider themselves to have recognized God and count themselves among those who walk the paths of certainty. At all times they have occupied themselves with the remembrance and words of the All-Merciful, so much so that they have not neglected the commandments of the all-knowing King for a single day; and if anyone has neglected them, that person has felt remorse.

**289** Yet they have suspended and are putting to death the Essence of the All-Merciful, the pure Being of the All-Glorious, to whose recognition they have professed to hold fast. They have never recognized Him and have deprived themselves of all divine outpourings and the glorious favors of the All-Merciful. They are in the depths of the fire, yet count themselves among the people of paradise. They are submerged in the sea of torment, yet consider themselves among the beloved of the Lord of Lords. At the utmost distance from God, they imagine themselves among those who are near Him.

**290** Therefore, people of the Bayān, place your trust at all times in the Beauty of the Lord of the worlds and seek refuge in Him, lest in My next Revelation you inflict upon My Beauty what those people have inflicted at this time.

**291** People of the Bayān, the people of the Qurʾān had no proof in hand except the Qurʾān, which distinguished truth from falsehood in those days. When My Beauty of merciful glory rose and shone from the horizon of My transcendent holiness, I manifested Myself with that same proof and testimony—indeed, with a greater one—so that through the earlier proof they might recognize the later proof and not deprive themselves of the sanctuary of acknowledgment of the Beauty of certainty. Yet they recite the verses of the Qurʾān every day while remaining shut out and deprived of these wondrous verses, whose authority as proof is as evident and radiant as the sun in the midst of heaven.

**292** Thus, when the glorious divine verses were revealed, some declared that these verses had been stolen from earlier books, while others said with heedless tongues that these verses arose from the source of self and desire. Thus We made them bear witness, if you are among those who witness. Matters reached such a point that, even as you sought recourse through My remembrance, you wounded My body, and while you prided yourselves on recognizing Me, you fired bullets of malice at My recognized Beauty.

**293** Such is the way of the world and its people. At last My gentle spirit was freed from the defilement of idolatrous souls and winged its way to the loftiest, most exalted seat of glory and the most holy, most unapproachable, all-glorious Companion. After My blessed spirit ascended to the all-glorious horizon, I look with the eye of favor and the gaze of loving-kindness upon those who claim to love Me, to see which of them act according to My counsels and obey My command.

**294** Then the Tongue of Eternity speaks from the all-glorious horizon and says: ‘People of the Bayān, this is My Beauty, who has appeared with My verses and My manifestations. Why have you disbelieved in Him and turned away from Him? It is thereby established that you have not believed in Me, just as at the time of My Revelation it was established that the people of the Qurʾān had not believed in Muḥammad, the Manifestation of My Self; just as in the Revelation of Muḥammad it became evident that the people of the Gospel had not believed in My Son; and just as, when the Spirit came, it became evident that the people of the Torah had not believed in Him who conversed with God. Go back, then, and consider, until the matter reaches the appearance of the first. Thus We impart to you some of the mysteries of what has been, so that within yourselves you may be among those who perceive.’

**295** Only a few days had passed since My martyrdom when a fresh favor shone from the region of all-glorious holiness and an exalted loving-kindness from the horizon of the highest glory. The pure Being of Eternity appeared from the paradise of the unseen in a most great and most bountiful Beauty, with the very proof that I had established as proof and the very testimony that had been acceptable before God. Indeed, He appeared with all the aspects of oneness, the manifestations of the glory of eternal self-sufficiency, the hidden depths of the unfathomable unseen, and the signs of unknowable glory.

**296** Yet you, people of the Bayān, have gathered from every direction around the most great Throne with the swords of rancor and insinuation, and at every moment you have struck this Beauty of exalted glory with the arrows of malice. I swear by My Beauty! If you look now and turn toward the truth, toward the most exalted Companion, you will see seas of blood flowing from My body and the marks of the swords of malice evident upon My limbs.

**297** Have you not reflected, after all, on why I sacrificed Myself and why all those swords of wickedness and bullets of hatred struck Me? It is abundantly clear that My purpose was nothing but recognition of the Manifestation of My Self. Yet when the Manifestation of My Self appeared in the fullness of revelation, you treated Him in the manner that has been witnessed.

**298** Now, if you are questioned at the place of the greatest gathering and asked about what you have done, what will you say in answer to the Lord of Lords? No, by God! You will have no power to speak, for only a few days have passed since My absence, and you have witnessed with your own eyes the full proof of the Revelation and all that befell Me. Yet you have become heedless of the Beauty through whose word all things, past and future, have been brought into being, and have remained shut out from the most exalted Vision by the veils of self and desire.

**299** People, throughout all the pages of the Bayān I gave everyone the glad tidings of this holy and eternal Revelation, and said that when this Luminary of supreme glory arose, you must not become occupied with anything created between the heavens and the earth and remain veiled from the Beauty of Eternity.

**300** I also expressly said: beware, people, lest at the time of the Revelation you be veiled by the Vāḥid of the Bayān. It was known that the Vāḥid of the Bayān is reckoned before God as the first of the creation of the Bayān, and that I have given it precedence over all.

**301** I also stated in an explicit text: beware, people, lest at the time of the Revelation you be veiled by what has been revealed in the Bayān. Yet now, people, because of a description revealed in the Bayān—when you do not know what is intended or whom it concerns, for no one has ever been aware of My intention—you have turned away from the One who brought that description into being, revealed it, manifested it, and fulfilled it, through a single word from whom such temples have been and continue to be created. If only you had been content with this! Instead, you have issued a decree for His death. By God, at every moment you have tormented this Essence of the All-Merciful like a serpent. You did not believe and did not recognize God; why, then, did you consent to His death and injury?

**302** I swear by My Beauty that you have not drunk from the cup of fairness or tasted the ocean of My good pleasure. You have not set foot on the right side of justice or passed through the quarter of those endowed with insight. You have counted error as guidance itself and regarded sheer idolatry as the essence of divine unity.”

**303** All of you have seen with your own outward eyes the person whom He protected for twenty years and who is still alive. Though He had power over him and knew what lay hidden within him, He sheltered him within His merciful protection. Nevertheless, that person arose to kill Him. When his intention and deed became known among the emigrants, he occupied himself with fabricated accusations solely to conceal his own vile deeds and cast doubt into minds prone to imagining things. He attributed his own acts and deeds to the Essence of Eternity, hoping thereby to draw the servants from the right hand of certitude to the left hand of delusion.

**304** You have denied what you have seen with your own eyes and perceived, and through fabricated accusations you have remained veiled from the Countenance of Oneness. I swear by the beauty of My transcendent holiness that what they have written about this manifest Beauty is proof to all of the falsehood of those who utter it and confirmation of this manifest Cause. For they have made allegations whose falsehood is more evident than the sun in the midst of heaven, since you have all associated with this Beauty of most exalted glory and have perceived according to your own capacity.

**305** Nevertheless, because of these fabricated words you have turned away from the Revealer of the verses of Oneness. Even if we concede that they are true, have you not known that the True One does whatever He wills, and have you not become certain that He decrees whatever He desires?

**306** Apart from all these considerations, this company who have emigrated with God on this journey have perceived most of these matters with their own eyes and hearts, and testify that the True One—exalted be His glory—has been and will remain distinguished in every respect from all besides Him. Nevertheless, you have deemed these souls liars, while you have regarded, and still regard, as truthful those who have never been aware of the matter and never will be, and who walk the paths of delusion and conjecture. Shame on you, you company of the deluded!

**307** I swear by My Beauty that God’s conclusive proof has been fully established for all, and His perfect Word has dawned from the horizon of truth. Today there is no refuge but His refuge, and no sheltering shade is to be seen but His. Listen to the call of your Beloved, hold fast to what you have seen with your own eyes, and loose your hold on the handle of delusion.

**308** If you look with the eye of truth, by God, the inhabitants of the Concourse on high are mourning and lamenting, and all the maidens of the heavenly chambers are sighing and wailing. The leaves of the Lote-Tree of the Utmost Boundary have withered through the oppression of these oppressors. By God, the True One, the breezes of the All-Merciful’s mercy have been cut off from the realm of contingent being, and the radiance of the lights of the All-Glorious Countenance has been withheld from the inhabitants of creation.

**309** By God, the True One, you have committed such oppression that all things have been severed from their own life. Today no creature remains—whether among the inhabitants of the Concourse on high, the dwellers in the cities of eternity, or those abiding in the ocean of names—who has not exchanged all the delights of joy for sorrow and put on a garment of black. The entire company of the cherubim and the realities of the Prophets and Messengers are lamenting in the chambers of established glory, while you, heedless ones of the earth, are joyful and wander through the land of the abyss in utter delight.

**310** You have slain the essence of religion, yet imagine yourselves seated on the thrones of religion and certitude. By God, O people, nothing like this Revelation has ever appeared, nor has the eye of contingent being ever beheld its like. Hear My call, and do not be among those punctilious ones who were found among the people of the Qur’an: so scrupulous were they that they took precautions over the blood of a gnat, yet issued rulings authorizing the shedding of the blood of God.

**311** They were occupied with remembrance, yet when the verses of the Sovereign of Remembrance were recited to that company, they cried out, “Leave aside these remembrances, and do not distract us from the remembrance of God!” Such were the deeds and actions witnessed from that company. And you, people of the Bayān, are committing and carrying out the very essence of those deeds in these days, while you have reckoned, and still reckon, yourselves to be of the True One.

**312** Thus I call God to witness, and His angels, His Prophets, His Messengers, those who circle around His throne, and all that He has created in the heavens and on earth, that I have not fallen short in conveying My message to you. I have delivered to you the messages of God at the time of My manifestation, at the time of My ascent, and at this time when I have manifested Myself from the All-Glorious Horizon. I have imparted to you wisdom and utterance, made known to you the beauty of the All-Merciful, and completed the testimony for you, the evidence against you, and the proof among you. No admonition remains that I have not conveyed to you.

**313** Thus, O my God, You know that I have not fallen short in Your Cause, and that I have conveyed to these people what You commanded Me before the creation of the heavens and the earth. I have explained to them the ways of Your justice and shown them the paths of Your good pleasure.

**314** Thus, O my God, have mercy on these people, and do not make them among those who turned away from Me, denied My right, and disputed My verses until they shed My blood and dismembered My limbs. O my God, strengthen them in Your Cause, then aid them with Your assistance. Do not deprive them of these breezes that have blown from this paradise which You have created at the heart of the gardens of heaven, and do not withhold from them the fragrances You have sent forth from the horizon of Your name, the All-Merciful.

**315** Thus, O my God, bring into being within their breasts, from the light of Your words, the fire of attraction to You, that through sheer power it may turn them toward the right hand of the throne of Your mercy. Then kindle within their hearts, O my God, the torches of love and longing for You, that through them the veils that have barred them from the court of Your nearness and Your presence may be burned away.

**316** Then take their hands, O my God, with the hands of power and might. Rescue them from the depths of delusion and desire, and bring them to the abode that You have sanctified beyond the allusions of all that has been created between earth and heaven. Then impart to them the word through which the hearts of those who know You are drawn to the heaven of the glory of Your loving-kindness, and the hearts of those brought near to You are drawn to the atmosphere of the holiness of Your favors.

**317** Then make them, O my Beloved, among those whom all who are in the heavens and on earth have not prevented from turning toward Your loving care, remaining steadfast in Your Cause, acknowledging Your presence, and attaining certainty of meeting You. You are indeed the Ever-Forgiving, the Merciful, the Bestower, the Almighty, the Munificent, the Helper, the All-Bountiful.
